Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAbyssalLiving.name: Untether
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAbyssalLiving.description: Plant a seed of Abyssal Energy on the enemy's heart. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes their heart to explode, dealing Physical damage in an area.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAlchemistsBoo.name: Alchemist's Boon
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAlchemistsBoo.description: While active, grants you Flask charges passively and causes Life and Mana recovery from your Flasks to also apply to Allies in your Presence.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAncestralCry.name: Ancestral Cry
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAncestralCry.description: Perform a Warcry using Glory gained by Igniting enemies to turn you into an embodiment of Kaom. While embodying Kaom, you Trigger Volcanic Steps while travelling, Melee Strikes and Slams are Ancestrally Boosted, and your Melee Strikes Trigger Volcanic Eruption.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemArchmage.name: Archmage
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemArchmage.description: While active, causes your Non-Channelling Spells to cost additional mana and deal extra Lightning damage, both based on your maximum Mana.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemArmourPiercin.name: Armour Piercing Rounds
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemArmourPiercin.description: Load your Crossbow with a clip of bolts that can be fired rapidly and Break enemy Armour. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyAli.name: Align Fate
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyAli.description: While active, visages of yourself from alternate timelines will occasionally appear and cast one of your Spells from your first valid Weapon Set. Until the next visage appears, your next cast of the same Spell aligns your fate, Empowering that Spell. Visages can only cast damaging, non-Channelling, non-Buff Spells you could cast that have no cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyAnc.name: Ancestral Spirits
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyAnc.description: This skill is Triggered each time you summon a Totem, summoning an Ancestral Spirit Minion to fight for you. If the Totem dies then the Ancestral Spirit triggered by it's summoning will die too.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyBle.name: Bleeding Concoction
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyBle.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Physical Attack damage in an area and Aggravating Bleeding on Enemies hit. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyBlo.name: Blood Boil
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyBlo.description: Enemies in your Presence accumulate blood boils periodically. When they die, the boils pop applying Corrupted Blood to enemies near them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyCor.name: Kelari's Malediction
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyCor.description: Harness Kelari's power to passively Consume Corpses in your Presence, causing Corpse Beetle Minions to burst forth. The Beetles passively follow you until Commanded. On your Command, they rush the target and explode.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyDem.name: Demon Form
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyDem.description: Shapeshift into a demon, vastly boosting the power of your Spells. You gain Demonflame every second you remain in demon form, causing your Life to be lost at an ever-increasing rate. Maximum 10 Demonflame. Revert to human form if you reach 1 Life, use a Skill that isn't a Spell, or reactivate this Skill.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyEle.name: Elemental Expression
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyEle.description: Create a fiery explosion, an arcing bolt of lightning, or an icy wave of projectiles. The chance for an explosion is proportional to your Strength, for a bolt proportional to your Dexterity, and for a wave proportional to your Intelligence.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyEle.name: Elemental Storm
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyEle.description: Create a stationary Fire, Cold or Lightning storm at a target location for a duration, based on the highest Elemental Damage type for the Hit that Triggered the storm. Hits which do not deal Elemental Damage will not Trigger the storm.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyEnc.name: Encase in Jade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyEnc.description: Consume all stacks of Jade to grant Guard based off your maximum Life for each Jade consumed. You cannot gain Jade stacks while you have Guard.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyExp.name: Explosive Concoction
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyExp.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Fire Attack damage in an area. Additional smaller flasks are thrown at nearby Ignited Enemies. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyFir.name: Fire Spell on Hit
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyFir.description: While active, gains Energy when you Hit enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed Fire spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyFul.name: Fulminating Concoction
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyFul.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Lightning Attack damage in an area with high chance to Shock. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyHol.name: Hollow Focus
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyHol.description: While active, ethereal bells periodically appear near you. Your Hits immediately destroy the bells, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies and causes a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. The bells are themselves always Primed for Stun, they can be Culled, and Hits against them are always Critical Hits.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyHol.name: Hollow Form
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyHol.description: Channel to create fleeting images of your astral self near the target location. The images perform a Socketed Melee Attack once then vanish, targeting the closest enemy if possible. The images cannot perform Channelled Skills or Conditional Skills. Consuming a Power Charge creates additional images.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyHol.name: Hollow Resonance
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyHol.description: Attaches an ethereal bell to your back. Critical Hits with other Skills will cause the bell to ring out, damaging nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyIne.name: Inevitable Agony
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyIne.description: Debuff all targets in an area, causing a portion of Damage they take from Hits to be tracked by the Debuff. When the debuff's duration expires or can kill the target, the target loses life equal to that tracked damage all at once.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyInf.name: Elemental Surge
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyInf.description: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyInt.name: Into the Breach
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyInt.description: Create a Breach around you, allowing you to see nearby Flames of Chayula. You are considered to be in a Breach while this skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyLif.name: Life Remnants
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyLif.description: Drink the blood of your enemies to restore your Life. While active, enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Life Remnant, and Hitting a target spawns a Life Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Life Remnant grants you Life which can Overflow maximum Life.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyMan.name: Manifest Weapon
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyMan.description: Manifest a copy of your main hand Melee Martial Weapon as an immortal Companion to fight by your side. In addition to its standard Strikes, the Manifested Weapon gains an additional Attack depending on its weapon type.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyMed.name: Meditate
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyMed.description: Channel to Recharge Energy Shield and allow that Recharge to Overflow. Channelling ends when you take damage or your Energy Shield is fully Overflowed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyMir.name: Mirage Deadeye
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyMir.description: While active, firing a ranged Projectile Attack will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanish.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyMom.name: Moment of Vulnerability
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyMom.description: Send out a temporal Nova to take advantage of enemies' moment of vulnerability. Hitting enemies that are Primed for Stun, Electrocution, or Freeze causes a visage of them to appear, lasting as long as the original target would have been affected by the form of Immobilisation used to create the visage. A portion of the damage dealt to visages is also dealt to the original.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyPoi.name: Acidic Concoction
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyPoi.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Physical Attack damage in an area. The thrown flask Consumes Poison on Hit to cause an acidic burst. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyQue.name: Queen's Procession
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyQue.description: While active, Sprinting turns you into a locust swarm which deals Physical Attack damage, which is not based on your Weapon's damage, in an area around you. You take damage and gain Heavy Stun buildup if this Hits any targets, but damage you take from other sources while sprinting will not apply Heavy Stun or interrupt your sprinting.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyRit.name: Ritual Sacrifice
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyRit.description: Sacrifice the Corpse of a Rare Monster to grant you its Modifiers for a duration, or gain a single random Modifier at the cost of your own life force.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySha.name: Shattering Concoction
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySha.description: Consume charges from your Mana Flask to throw a flask that explodes, dealing Cold Attack damage in an area and inflicting Exposure. This damage is not based on your unarmed damage, so this is not considered an Unarmed Attack.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySor.name: Sorcery Ward
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySor.description: Passively manifests a protective barrier which takes Elemental Damage from Hits for you until depleted. The barrier instantly recharges to its full value a short time after it stops taking damage or is fully depleted.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySum.name: Ruzhan, the Blazing Sword
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySum.description: Summon Ruzhan, an invulnerable Flame Djinn Minion, to do your bidding. Ruzhan emerges to Strike enemies with his greatsword whenever you use a damaging Skill, and casts devastating Fire Spells when Commanded to do so.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySum.name: Summon Infernal Hound
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySum.description: Activate to summon a Reviving Infernal Hound which Ignites enemies near it.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySum.name: Kelari, the Tainted Sands
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySum.description: Summon Kelari, an invulnerable Sand Djinn Minion, to do your bidding. Kelari will only act when you Command him to do so. Kelari delivers swift Hits with massive Critical Hit potential.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySum.name: Navira, the Last Mirage
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancySum.description: Summon Navira, an invulnerable Water Djinn Minion to do your bidding. Navira will only act when you Command her to do so, bestowing restorative blessings upon you and your Allies with her Spells.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyTem.name: Temper Weapon
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyTem.description: Channel to temper your main hand Melee Martial Weapon. Each hit of the hammer against the anvil Empowers subsequent Attacks to Combust when Hitting enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyTem.name: Temporal Rift
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyTem.description: While active, passively leaves afterimages of your recent past. Cast the Spell to return to the oldest afterimage, teleporting to that location and resetting your Life, Mana and Energy Shield to the values they had at the time. Removes any upcoming damage delayed by Phased Form on use.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyTim.name: Time Freeze
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyTim.description: Release a large wave that stops time for all affected enemies for a duration. Duration is lower the more times the enemy has had time stopped for them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyTim.name: Time Snap
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyTim.description: Manipulate time, resetting the cooldowns of your other Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyUnb.name: Unbound Avatar
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyUnb.description: Gain Unbound Fury by inflicting Elemental Ailments with Hits on enemies. Once you reach maximum Unbound Fury, consume it to become Unbound for a duration, vastly augmenting your Elemental prowess.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyUnl.name: Unleash
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyUnl.description: Augment yourself with temporal magic for a short duration, Empowering the next Repeatable Spell you cast to Repeat multiple times. Cannot Empower Skills with a Cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyViv.name: Vivid Stampede
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyViv.description: Call upon Spirits of the Stag, sending them leaping forward. Each Stag releases a damaging shockwave each time it lands, and any Stags that travel the maximum possible distance also leave behind Shocked Ground.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyVoi.name: Void Illusion
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendancyVoi.description: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will cause damaging explosions. Copies created this way have 1 Life.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendanyMeta.name: Called Shots
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAscendanyMeta.description: Applies a socketed Mark Skill to a nearby unmarked Enemy every few seconds. Consuming socketed Marks will cause them to be reapplied to an unmarked Enemy. This reapplication can happen at most once every few seconds.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAttrition.name: Attrition
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemAttrition.description: While active, causes you to deal more Hit damage to Rare and Unique enemies the longer you've been fighting them, and gain Culling Strike against them once you've been fighting them for long enough.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBarkskin.name: Barkskin
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBarkskin.description: While active, taking Hit damage from enemies to your Energy Shield causes you to gain Armour for a short duration. Armour gained from multiple Hits can stack. The total Armour gained from this Skill cannot exceed the Item Armour on your Equipped Armour Items.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBearFuryOfThe.name: Fury of the Mountain
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBearFuryOfThe.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and repeatedly pound the ground, creating Molten Fissures that travel randomly in a wide arc in front of you.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBerserk.name: Berserk
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBerserk.description: While active, strengthens your Rage, but causes you to lose Life while not losing Rage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBlackPowderBl.name: Black Powder Blitz
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBlackPowderBl.description: Replaces your dodge roll with an explosive-assisted leap, firing off a round from your prosthetic cannon leg that Blinds and Ignites enemies in the area you escape from. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBlink.name: Blink
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBlink.description: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown Spell that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBlinkSandPlay.name: Blink
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBlinkSandPlay.description: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown Spell that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBloodhoundsMa.name: Bloodhound's Mark
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBloodhoundsMa.description: Mark a target, making them suffer Heavy Stun build up from Blood Loss. The Mark will Activate, Consuming itself to Trigger Blood Explosion, when they are Heavy Stunned, or when they are killed if they suffered enough Blood Loss. The Mark's duration does not expire while the Marked target is suffering Blood Loss.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBoneBlast.name: Bone Blast
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBoneBlast.description: Conjure a circle of ritual inscriptions that last for a short duration. When the duration ends, spikes of bone erupt from enemies in the area, damaging them and potentially causing Bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBoneCage.name: Bone Cage
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBoneCage.description: Raise a ring of bone spikes around you. The spikes are destroyed when enemies touch them, damaging and Pinning those enemies. Raising a new ring of spikes destroys the previous one.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBonestorm.name: Bonestorm
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemBonestorm.description: Channel to conjure a swarm of bone spikes in the air, then release to fire them at enemies and explode. Shrapnel Impales enemies Hit, causing subsequent Attack Hits against those targets to deal extra damage. Consumes your Power Charges to cause much larger explosions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemChaoticInfusi.name: Chaotic Surge
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemChaoticInfusi.description: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemChargeInfusio.name: Charge Regulation
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemChargeInfusio.description: While active, you gain powerful Buffs based on your active Charges. However, maintaining the Buff Consumes Charges every few seconds.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemClusterGrenad.name: Cluster Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemClusterGrenad.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that explodes when its fuse expires, throwing out a ring of mini Grenades that explode when they come to a stop.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemColdSnap.name: Snap
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemColdSnap.description: Consume the elemental energy from a Frozen, Shocked or Ignited enemy, creating an elemental blast that leaves behind an Infusion Remnant. The blast will spread to other enemies affected by the same Ailment, but those blasts cannot spread further. Can also be cast on a Frostbolt to create a larger cold blast.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemCombatFrenzy.name: Combat Frenzy
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemCombatFrenzy.description: While active, grants you a Frenzy Charge when you Freeze, Electrocute or Pin an enemy. This can only occur once every few seconds.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemConvalescence.name: Convalescence
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemConvalescence.description: While active, grants a skill that you can use to instantly begin Recharging Energy Shield and gain a Buff for a duration that prevents that Recharge being interrupted. The Buff is removed at maximum Energy Shield and the skill cannot be used while Energy Shield is full.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemCrossbowRequi.name: Requiem
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemCrossbowRequi.description: Your weapon passively accumulates anguish from the tormented souls within. When fully charged, use this skill to compose the Requiem, transforming your Crossbow shot into a torrent of anguish for a short, fixed amount of time. Does not use Ammunition.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemCullTheWeak.name: Cull The Weak
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemCullTheWeak.description: Dash to an enemy and run them through, Culling enemies if their life is low enough. If this Attack kills at least one enemy, it grants you a Frenzy Charge, with higher Rarity monsters granting additional Charges. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDarkEffigy.name: Dark Effigy
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDarkEffigy.description: Raise a Totem that bombards enemies afflicted by Chaos damage over time Debuffs.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDefianceBanne.name: Defiance Banner
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDefianceBanne.description: While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Armour, Evasion and movement speed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDetonateMinio.name: Detonate Minion
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDetonateMinio.description: Detonate an allied Minion whose current Life is below a threshold, dealing heavy Attack damage to nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDetonatingArr.name: Detonating Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDetonatingArr.description: Channel to charge up before firing off a burning arrow. At maximum stages, the arrow will create a Detonating explosion at the end of its flight.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDreadBanner.name: Dread Banner
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemDreadBanner.description: While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Elemental Ailment Threshold, Maximum Elemental Resistances and Flask charges.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElectrocuting.name: Electrocuting Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElectrocuting.description: Fire an electrifying arrow that explodes in an Area on Hit. Hitting an enemy will attach an Electrocuting Rod to them, causing all incoming Lightning damage to build up Electrocution. This rod is removed when the enemy is next Electrocuted.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalConf.name: Elemental Conflux
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalConf.description: Tap into a current of raw and unpredictable Elemental power, causing you to deal greatly more damage of a randomly chosen Element. The Element affected changes frequently, though the same Element can be affected multiple times in succession.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalInvo.name: Elemental Invocation
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalInvo.description: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock or Ignite an enemy. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalSiph.name: Elemental Siphon
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalSiph.description: Dash to an enemy and nullify their Resistance. Hitting an enemy with positive Elemental Resistance will reduce their highest Elemental Resistance to 0 for a duration and triggers Infuse Weapon, granting your Spear the maximum possible Surges corresponding to the removed Resistance. If this skill doesn't remove any Resistances, its cooldown is reset. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalSund.name: Elemental Sundering
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalSund.description: Plunge your Spear into the ground to emit a pulse that Consumes Freeze, Shock and Ignite on a number of nearby enemies, Allies and Corpses. The pulse itself deals no damage, but each Ailment Consumed causes an explosion of the corresponding elemental damage type.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalWeak.name: Elemental Weakness
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemElementalWeak.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Elemental Resistances.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemEmergencyRelo.name: Emergency Reload
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemEmergencyRelo.description: Instantly reload all your Crossbow Ammunition clips and Empower each clip's Ammunition to deal more damage for a duration.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemEntangle.name: Entangle
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemEntangle.description: Conjures a rootbound fissure that crawls forward, damaging enemies in its path. While the fissure persists, vines lash out from it and attach to nearby enemies, damaging and Slowing them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemExplodingPois.name: Bursting Fen Toad
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemExplodingPois.description: This skill creates a toad that jumps around briefly, the toad then explodes, dealing Attack damage in an area and inflicting Poison.  Damage you deal with this skill is not based on your Weapon.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemExplosiveGren.name: Explosive Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemExplosiveGren.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a devastating fiery blast when its fuse expires.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemExplosiveShot.name: Explosive Shot
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemExplosiveShot.description: Load your Crossbow with flaming bolts that explode on impact. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemExplosiveSpea.name: Explosive Spear
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemExplosiveSpea.description: Hurl a single payload Spear that pierces through enemies and lodges in terrain where it lands. The Spear will explode at the end of its Detonation Time or if Detonated. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if you have one to explode immediately, dealing more damage in a cross-shaped area and creating Ignited Ground.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFangsOfFrost.name: Fangs of Frost
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFangsOfFrost.description: Perform an icy stab that exploits enemies who are already off balance. Hitting a Parried target Consumes the Debuff to cause an explosion of frost and leave Chilled Ground.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFeastOfFlesh.name: Feast of Flesh
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFeastOfFlesh.description: Consume Corpses near you to recover Life and Mana over a short time per Corpse Consumed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFeralInvocati.name: Feral Invocation
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFeralInvocati.description: While active, gains Energy when you spend Mana. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to create visages which attack once with a socketed Shapeshifting Attack, creating multiple visages if it has enough Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFireball.name: Fireball
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFireball.description: Launch a large ball of Fire which explodes on impact. The explosion Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to launch a ring of smaller firebolts.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFlameLink.name: [DNT] Flame Link
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFlameLink.description: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they deal additional fire damage based on your life. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFlashGrenade.name: Flash Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFlashGrenade.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a Blinding, Stunning explosion when its fuse expires.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemForgeHammer.name: Forge Hammer
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemForgeHammer.description: Hurl a fiery hammer that Slams into the ground and lodges there. While the hammer is lodged in the ground, reusing this Skill recalls the hammer and resets the Skill's cooldown. Alternatively, using a Warcry near the lodged hammer causes it to shatter, releasing a number of Molten Fissures in a spiral.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFortifyingCry.name: Fortifying Cry
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFortifyingCry.description: Perform a Warcry that grants Guard and Triggers Shield Wave when subsequent Shield Attacks deal damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFragmentation.name: Fragmentation Rounds
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFragmentation.description: Load your Crossbow with Piercing bolts that fragment in flight. Bolts that hit a Frozen enemy Consume the Freeze and cause an explosion of shrapnel. Bolts that hit an Ice Crystal cause it to explode. These fragments can Merge.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFreezingMark.name: Freezing Mark
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFreezingMark.description: Mark a target, making them more susceptible to being Frozen. When the Marked target is Frozen, the Mark Activates, granting you a Buff which gives extra Cold damage and Consuming the Mark. Marking another target while you have the Buff will remove the Buff.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFreezingSalvo.name: Freezing Salvo
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFreezingSalvo.description: Passively gains Seals over time. Using the skill fires a projectile, and breaks the Seals, Repeating for each of them, and for each additional projectile the skill is given. For each time it Repeats normally, it will also Repeat an additional time targeting a different Ice Fragment in its area of effect if able, Detonating those Ice Fragments immediately.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFrostDarts.name: Frost Darts
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFrostDarts.description: Conjures a number of icy Projectiles that launch towards the target. Projectiles that Hit a Chilled or Frozen target create chunks of ice that deal additional damage on impacting the ground. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to cause each Projectile to lodge into the enemy then explode.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFrozenLocus.name: Frozen Locus
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFrozenLocus.description: Leap backward and crack the ground with your staff to call forth an Ice Crystal which can be damaged by you and enemies. If the Crystal is destroyed it causes an icy explosion. This skill can be used while using other skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFulmination.name: Fulmination
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemFulmination.description: While active, the first time any Skill Hits a Shocked enemy in your Presence, that Skill also Hits other Shocked enemies in your Presence, up to a maximum.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGalvanicShard.name: Galvanic Shards
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGalvanicShard.description: Load your Crossbow with charged bolts that fragment in flight, releasing Chaining Lightning beams when they Hit enemies. These fragments can Merge.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGasArrow.name: Gas Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGasArrow.description: Fire a noxious arrow at the ground, creating a cloud of flammable poisonous gas at the end of its flight. The cloud will detonate if hit by a Detonator skill or if an Ignited enemy touches it, creating a fiery explosion.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGasGrenade.name: Gas Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGasGrenade.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that causes a burst of Poison gas when its fuse expires, damaging enemies and leaving behind a growing Poison cloud. Burning effects or Detonator skills will cause the cloud to explode in a fiery blast.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGatheringStor.name: Gathering Storm
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGatheringStor.description: Flip backward and Channel to charge your Quarterstaff with Lightning. Releasing causes you to dash towards the target location, damaging enemies along the way. Releasing with Perfect Timing performs a Lightning-assisted dash that releases shockwaves from enemies you dash through. Perfectly Timed dash also explodes Tempest Bells on hit creating a shockwave that deals more damage and has a larger area, leaving Shocked Ground in its wake. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGeminiSurge.name: Gemini Surge
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGeminiSurge.description: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGlacialBolt.name: Glacial Bolt
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGlacialBolt.description: Load your Crossbow with icy bolts that create two walls of Ice Crystals at the end of their flight.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGrimFeast.name: Grim Feast
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemGrimFeast.description: While active, your Reviving Minions store a percentage of their maximum Life in a collectible Grim Remnant on death. Using Grim Resurrection Consumes the Life you've collected to Revive up to that much total Life of dead Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHailstormRoun.name: Hailstorm Rounds
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHailstormRoun.description: Passively generate bolts of ice at a frequency equal to reload time, up to a cap. Activate to Load the accumulated bolts into your Crossbow. All loaded bolts are fired at once, causing them to rain down over the target area.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHammerOfNgama.name: [DNT] Hammer of Ngamahu
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHammerOfNgama.description: DNT Build Glory by Break Armour and Igniting enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may entreat the Ancestors to crush your enemies, manifesting a massive hammer that falls from the sky onto your target, Slamming into the ground after a short duration and dealing immense damage based on your weapon.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHammerOfTheGo.name: Hammer of the Gods
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHammerOfTheGo.description: Build Glory by Heavy Stunning enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may entreat the Ancestors to crush your enemies, manifesting a massive hammer that falls from the sky onto your target, Slamming into the ground after a short duration and dealing immense damage based on your weapon.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHandOfChayula.name: Hand of Chayula
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHandOfChayula.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, triggering socketed Marks with increased effect and applying socketed Curses with increased duration.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHeartOfIce.name: Heart of Ice
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHeartOfIce.description: Chills all enemies in your Presence.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHeraldOfBlood.name: Herald of Blood
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHeraldOfBlood.description: While active, killing an enemy with Blood Loss will cause a bloody explosion that deals Physical Attack damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your Weapon, but is partially based on their accumulated Blood Loss. The explosion destroys their Corpse if the enemy was Normal or Magic, and has a chance to Aggravate Bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHeraldOfPlagu.name: Herald of Plague
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHeraldOfPlagu.description: While active, killing a Poisoned enemy spreads its Poison to other nearby enemies, and has a chance to also Hinder them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHighVelocityR.name: High Velocity Rounds
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHighVelocityR.description: Load your Crossbow with Piercing bolts that apply Riven Armour to enemies with Fully Broken Armour, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHydra.name: Hydra Familiar
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemHydra.description: While active, a companion Hydra will rear up from your body and regularly cast socketed Projectile Spells at nearby Shocked, Frozen, and Ignited enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIceShards.name: Ice Shards
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIceShards.description: Load your Crossbow with a clip of icy bolts that rapidly fire at the ground, leaving a shard of ice at the impact location that arms after a duration. After arming, the ice shards explode when enemies step on them, dealing more damage the longer they have been armed, up to a maximum. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIceShot.name: Ice Shot
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIceShot.description: Fire an icy arrow that sprays a cone of ice shards when it hits a target.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIceTippedArro.name: Ice-Tipped Arrows
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIceTippedArro.description: Ready your active Bow or Spear, Empowering your next Repeatable Bow or Projectile Spear Attacks to Convert Physical Damage to Cold Damage and Trigger Ice Fragments on Hit. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge. Cannot Empower Sustained Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIcestorm.name: Icestorm
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIcestorm.description: Conjure a hail of icy bolts over the targeted area. Chill and Freeze on enemies in front of you are Consumed to fuel the Icestorm by creating improved bolts.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIncendiarySho.name: Incendiary Shot
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIncendiarySho.description: Load your Crossbow with flaming bolts that fragment in flight, damaging and Igniting enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. These fragments can Merge.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemInternecineDr.name: [DNT] Internecine Draw
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemInternecineDr.description: DNT Gain stack of cleansed and corrupted forms when attacking with a bow.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIronWard.name: Iron Ward
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemIronWard.description: While active, stores a percentage of the Physical damage that is prevented by your Armour or other sources of damage reduction. Using this Skill releases the stored damage as a nova of spikes.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemLightlessStal.name: [DNT] Lightless Stalker
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemLightlessStal.description: Summons an immortal Lightless Stalker Minion which puts enemies it Hits under the Watcher's Gaze. Killing those enemies, or Hitting them if Rare or Unique, causes this skill to summon temporary Foul Eye Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemLightningRod.name: Lightning Rod
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemLightningRod.description: Fire an arrow that drops from above, creating a Lightning burst. The arrow remains in the ground, and any Chaining Lightning beams can Chain to it. When Chained to, the arrows charge up for a brief period before releasing another Lightning burst. The Lightning Arrow Skill reduces this delay, causing bursts to happen more quickly.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemLivingBombPla.name: Living Bomb
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemLivingBombPla.description: Plant a seed of Fire inside an enemy. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes the seed to explode, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind a Fire Infusion Remnant.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemLunarAssault.name: Lunar Assault
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemLunarAssault.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and swipe with your claws, projecting an arc of moonlight and ice forward in a crescent.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMagmaBarrier.name: Magma Barrier
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMagmaBarrier.description: While active, increases your Block Chance passively and imbues your Shield with lava over time. When fully imbued, your next Block with your Shield raised will expend the lava to Trigger the Magma Spray skill and grant you an Endurance Charge.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMagneticSalvo.name: Magnetic Salvo
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMagneticSalvo.description: Aim skyward and fire energy missiles at lingering bolts or arrows created by other Lightning Attacks in front of you. The missiles explode if they land close to a lingering bolt or arrow, dealing more damage in a larger area but destroying that bolt or arrow in the process.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMalice.name: Malice
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMalice.description: While active, emits an Aura that continuously inflicts Critical Weakness on enemies in your Presence.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemManaDrain.name: Mana Drain
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemManaDrain.description: Leech Mana from an enemy over a prolonged period, as well as briefly Hindering them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemManaRemnants.name: Mana Remnants
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemManaRemnants.description: Conjure surging arcane energy to restore your Mana. While active, enemies you kill affected by Elemental Ailments have a chance to spawn a Mana Remnant, and Critically Hitting a target with Elemental Ailments spawns a Mana Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Mana Remnant grants you Mana which can Overflow maximum Mana.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMantraOfDestr.name: Mantra of Destruction
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMantraOfDestr.description: Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to Empower your next Quarterstaff Attack, causing it to deal additional Chaos damage. Each kill with the Empowered Attack grants Purple Flames of Chayula for a duration.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMirageArcher.name: Mirage Archer
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMirageArcher.description: While active, dodge rolling will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanish.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMoltenBlast.name: Molten Blast
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMoltenBlast.description: Gouge molten rock from the ground and fling it at the target. The Projectile explodes on collision, damaging enemies and scattering shrapnel in a cone behind it.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMortarCannon.name: Mortar Cannon
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemMortarCannon.description: Raise a cannon Ballista Totem which uses socketed Grenade Skills, with significantly improved Cooldown Recovery Rate.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemOilBarrage.name: Oil Barrage
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemOilBarrage.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and spit Oil at enemies, creating Oil Ground where the Projectiles land. Consumes Power Charges if possible to instead Channel a sustained barrage of electrified Oil that does not create Oil Ground. Projectiles are fired in sequence, allowing multiple Projectiles to Hit the same target.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemOilGrenade.name: Oil Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemOilGrenade.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that bursts in a spray of Oil when the fuse expires or when it impacts an Enemy, dealing minimal damage but covering the ground and nearby enemies in Oil. Oil created this way can be Ignited by Detonator Skills or Ignited Ground.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemOverwhelmingP.name: Overwhelming Presence
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemOverwhelmingP.description: While active, emits an Aura that makes enemies in your Presence easier to Stun and inflict Elemental Ailments upon.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemParry.name: Parry
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemParry.description: Ready your Buckler to parry the next Hit you would take, Blocking the Hit and retaliating with a quick sweep that leaves enemies off balance, causing them to take massively increased Attack damage for a short duration. Parrying causes you to accumulate Heavy Stun buildup. You cannot Evade a Hit you could parry, but Evasion instead grants an equal chance to avoid this Heavy Stun buildup.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPerfectStrike.name: Perfect Strike
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPerfectStrike.description: Channel to charge up your weapon with Fire. Releasing with Perfect Timing will create a damaging wave of intense Fire.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPermafrostBol.name: Permafrost Bolts
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPermafrostBol.description: Load your Crossbow with icy bolts that fragment in flight, damaging enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. The icy coating on the bolts makes them extremely potent at Freezing enemies. These fragments can Merge.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPhantasmalArr.name: Phantasmal Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPhantasmalArr.description: Fires an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, the arrow explodes in spectral flame, turning it to ashes and damaging enemies, with a high chance to Ignite. Igniting any enemy with the Explosion also applies Ignite to enemies within range.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPinnacleOfPow.name: Pinnacle of Power
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPinnacleOfPow.description: Consume all Power Charges to master the elements, gaining Elemental Damage and the ability to apply Elemental Ailments with other damage types. Can only be used while you have maximum Power Charges.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlasmaBlast.name: Plasma Blast
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlasmaBlast.description: Load your Crossbow with unstable bolts that require a lengthy charging period to fire but deal devastating damage, Pierce through enemies, and explode upon hitting terrain. Additional Projectiles are fired in a spread, unlike other Crossbow Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlayerDefault.name: Bow Shot
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlayerDefault.description: Fire an arrow with your Bow.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlayerDefault.name: Crossbow Shot
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlayerDefault.description: Fire a bolt from your crossbow.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlayerDefault.name: Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlayerDefault.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a shrapnel blast when its fuse expires.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlayerDefault.name: Spear Throw
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlayerDefault.description: Hurl your Spear with force. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if you have one to cause the Spear to explode at the end of its flight.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlaytestAttac.name: Playtest Attack
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlaytestAttac.description: Strike your foes down with a powerful blow using a melee weapon.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlaytestSlam.name: Playtest Slam
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlaytestSlam.description: Jump into the air, damaging enemies where you land.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlaytestSpell.name: Playtest Spell
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPlaytestSpell.description: Launch a fiery Projectile towards a target.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPoisonBurstAr.name: Poisonburst Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPoisonBurstAr.description: Fire a virulent arrow that creates a burst of Poison on hit, affecting all enemies in an area.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPrimalAvatar.name: Primal Avatar
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPrimalAvatar.description: Conjure Azmeri wisps to engulf a Rare Beast for a duration, Hindering them. If you defeat the Beast while it is engulfed in wisps, it will be captured by this gem, transforming the gem to instead allow you to summon the Beast as a Reviving Companion.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPrimalBounty.name: Primal Bounty
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPrimalBounty.description: Empowers the next Projectile Skill you use, causing it to create additional Projectiles and fly faster.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPrimalStrikes.name: Primal Strikes
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemPrimalStrikes.description: Perform a Lightning-charged stab that can be chained into a combination of up to three attacks. The first two attacks conjure a charging Wildwood spirit if they Hit a Shocked enemy and refresh Shock duration. The third attack is a large swipe that inflicts Elemental Exposure, and can Consume Shock to conjure a stampede of spirits.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemProfaneRitual.name: Profane Ritual
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemProfaneRitual.description: Mark a Corpse with a profane rune, dealing Chaos damage over time to nearby enemies. When the ritual is complete the Corpse is consumed and you gain a Power Charge.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRagingSpirits.name: Raging Spirits
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRagingSpirits.description: While active, Fire Spells you use yourself will also summon Raging Spirits, which are short-lived flaming skulls that rush at nearby enemies and rapidly Attack them, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRake.name: Rake
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRake.description: Dash towards an enemy and perform a lacerating slash, inflicting Bleeding on all enemies struck.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRapidShot.name: Rapid Shot
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRapidShot.description: Load your Crossbow with a large clip of heated bolts. Heat builds up on your Crossbow as you fire them, and reaching maximum Heat will prevent you from firing or reloading these bolts for a short time. However, other Skills can Consume Heat for extra benefits. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRavenousSwarm.name: Ravenous Swarm
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRavenousSwarm.description: While active and enemies are present, swarms of insects emerge from your body to pursue nearby enemies. The swarms are untargetable Minions that Attack and Poison enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemReapersInvoca.name: Reaper's Invocation
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemReapersInvoca.description: While active, gains Energy when you kill an enemy with a Melee Attack. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRedQueenVisag.name: [DNT] Red Queen's Visage
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemRedQueenVisag.description: DNT A host of crimson souls erupt from Atziri's Mirror when you Parry, which travel outward to enemies in front of you applying the Parried Debuff and Scar of the Red Queen.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemResonatingShi.name: Resonating Shield
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemResonatingShi.description: Repeatedly hammer your Shield with your weapon causing damaging shockwaves in an area around you. Enemies hit by the shockwave lose Armour for a duration. While Channelling Resonating Shield, your Shield is raised and you will Block all incoming Blockable hits.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSacrifice.name: Sacrifice
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSacrifice.description: While active, your undead Reviving Minions can be used in place of Corpses by your skills, but your Minions Revive more slowly.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSanguineRevel.name: Sanguine Revelry
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSanguineRevel.description: Conjure hateful energy to fuel your Rage and Life. While active, Bleeding enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Hateful Remnant, and Hitting a Bleeding target spawns a Hateful Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Hateful Remnant grants you Rage and recovers Life based on your current Rage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemScavengedPlat.name: Scavenged Plating
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemScavengedPlat.description: While active, uses fragments of armour scavenged from enemies to bolster your own. Fully Breaking an enemy's Armour grants you stacks of Scavenged Plating for a duration based on the enemy's Rarity, and you gain Armour and Thorns per stack. Normal enemies grant 1 stack, Magic enemies grant 2 stacks, Rare enemies grant 5 stacks and Unique enemies grant 10 stacks.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShardScavenge.name: Shard Scavenger
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShardScavenge.description: While active, Consuming Freeze, Shock, Ignite, or Fully Broken Armour on an enemy reloads your Crossbow, restores one cooldown use for your Grenades and grants a Buff causing Crossbow Attacks to not consume bolts for a duration. This can only occur once every few seconds.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShieldBlock.name: Raise Shield
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShieldBlock.description: Raise your Shield to Block all incoming Blockable hits. Release immediately after Blocking when an enemy is close to perform a Shield Bash, damaging and Stunning enemies. While your Shield is raised you cannot be Light Stunned by hits you Block, but Blocking too much damage may Heavy Stun you. You cannot Evade while your Shield is raised, but Evasion instead grants an equal chance to avoid this Heavy Stun buildup.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShieldWall.name: Shield Wall
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShieldWall.description: Ram your Shield into the ground, throwing up a wall of earth. Enemies can attack your wall segments, and your Slams, Warcries, and Shield Charge will instantly shatter them all. The segments explode when shattered, damaging enemies in front of and around them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShockburstRou.name: Shockburst Rounds
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShockburstRou.description: Load your Crossbow with a clip of charged bolts which release damaging pulses upon Hitting an enemy affected by a Lightning Ailment. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShockchainArr.name: Shockchain Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemShockchainArr.description: Fire a Lightning-charged arrow that homes in on enemies afflicted by Lightning Ailments. Hitting such an enemy will cause your arrow to release a damaging shockwave and Chain towards nearby targets, with those Chaining Hits also releasing a shockwave. After the final Chain, the arrow lodges into the ground as a Lightning Rod. Consumes Shock from enemies it Hits, but not Electrocution.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSiegeCascade.name: Siege Cascade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSiegeCascade.description: Load your Crossbow with enemy-seeking payloads which are fired into the air, dropping a bolt near every enemy in the target area. These bolts lodge in the ground and explode after a short delay.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSiphonElement.name: Siphon Elements
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSiphonElement.description: While active, has a chance to create an Infusion Remnant when you Freeze, Shock or Ignite a target.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSiphoningStri.name: Siphoning Strike
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSiphoningStri.description: Dash to a target and Strike them with your Quarterstaff. If the target is Shocked, Consume their Shock to release a Lightning shockwave around the target and grant you a Power Charge. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSnipe.name: Snipe
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSnipe.description: Channel to charge up your bow before releasing a powerful shot. Releasing with Perfect Timing causes the arrow to explode on impact and Consume Freeze on directly Hitting. Consuming Freeze enhances the explosion.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSolarOrb.name: Solar Orb
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSolarOrb.description: Create a fiery Orb that periodically releases fiery pulses. Enemies that are very close to the Orb are Ignited. Flameblast can target a Solar Orb to be centred on the Orb instead of your location.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSoulLink.name: [DNT] Soul Link
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSoulLink.description: Targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, your Energy Shield will intercept some of the damage they would take. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be triggered, or used by Totems, Traps, or Mines.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSoulOffering.name: Soul Offering
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSoulOffering.description:
Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike, granting you a powerful Spell damage Buff as long as the spike remains. Does not affect your Minions. 
The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSpearOfSolari.name: Spear of Solaris
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSpearOfSolari.description: Build Glory by inflicting Freeze, Shock or Ignite on enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may call forth the Azmeri goddess Solaris, jumping backwards and throwing your Spear in the air. On landing the spear deals heavy damage in an area, then calls a divine skybeam that pulses periodically and creates expanding Ignited Ground. Modifiers to number of Projectiles fired do not apply to this skill.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSpearWindVort.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Spear Vortex
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSpearWindVort.description: DNT-UNUSED Performs a sweeping Spear Attack which draws Enemies in range closer to you.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSpellslinger.name: Spellslinger
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemSpellslinger.description: While active, gains Energy when you cast Spells. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStampede.name: Stampede
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStampede.description: Charges forward, cracking the earth and leaving a patch of Jagged Ground with every footstep. At the end of your charge, a massive leaping Slam damages enemies and causes all nearby patches of Jagged Ground to explode, damaging enemies standing on them. Once you begin your charge, the use speed of this Skill is affected by movement speed instead of Attack speed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStormLance.name: Storm Lance
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStormLance.description: Throw an electrified Spear that lodges in the ground and periodically zaps nearby enemies with Lightning bolts. If the Spear is Detonated by another Skill, it immediately unleashes a volley of bolts and expires. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to fire bolts more frequently for a shorter duration, automatically Detonate at the end of its duration, and create Shocked Ground on Detonation.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStormWave.name: Storm Wave
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStormWave.description: Sweep your Quarterstaff, projecting a bolt of Lightning through the ground in a long fissure ahead of you.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStormblastBol.name: Stormblast Bolts
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStormblastBol.description: Load your Crossbow with charged bolts that land around the target location and explode if hit by a Detonator Skill. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStormcallerAr.name: Stormcaller Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemStormcallerAr.description: Fire an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, a Lightning Bolt strikes the arrow, disintegrating it and damaging enemies, with a high chance to Shock. Shocking any enemy with the Bolt also applies Shock to all enemies near the impact.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTameBeast.name: Tame Beast
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTameBeast.description: Conjure Azmeri wisps to engulf a Rare Beast for a duration, Hindering them. If you defeat the Beast while it is engulfed in wisps, it will be captured by this gem, transforming the gem to instead allow you to summon the Beast as a Reviving Companion.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTempestBell.name: Tempest Bell
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTempestBell.description: Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to cause the Bell on your staff to grow to massive size as you drop it on the ground. The Bell damages enemies on impact and can be Hit by your skills, creating a damaging shockwave. Elemental Ailments applied to the Bell cause its shockwaves to deal extra damage of the corresponding type, and Hits which would have caused Knockback increase the area of effect of the shockwaves.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemThrashingVine.name: Thrashing Vines
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemThrashingVine.description: Spur the growth of huge vines, which emerge randomly within the target area. The vines crash to the ground then retreat, targeting nearby enemies if possible.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemThunderousLea.name: Thunderous Leap
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemThunderousLea.description: Leap into the air and plunge your Spear into the ground at the target location, emitting a Lightning-charged shockwave.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTimeOfNeed.name: Time of Need
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTimeOfNeed.description: While active, periodically invokes divine blessings to heal you and remove Curses and Elemental Ailments from you.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTornadoShot.name: Tornado Shot
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTornadoShot.description: Fire a skyward shot that whips up a Tornado where it lands, dealing Physical damage over time and Hindering enemies standing in it. Arrows, thrown Spears and Crossbow bolts fired at the Tornado are sucked into it, causing the Tornado to spit out a ring of copied Projectiles. Copied Projectiles cannot be copied again, even by further Tornados.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemToxicDomain.name: Toxic Domain
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemToxicDomain.description: Create an area of Toxic Bloom on the ground around you. While in the Bloom, you have increased Skill costs, Regenerate Life, and your Projectile Attacks attach a Toxic Pustule, which can be Poisoned. Pustules will Detonate after a duration or when enough Poison has been applied, dealing more damage based on the stored Poison damage and applying Poison in an area around it.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemToxicGrowth.name: Toxic Growth
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemToxicGrowth.description: Fire a rain of Toxic Pustules into the air. The Pustules deal damage on impact, then Detonate after a delay. They can also be Poisoned, causing them to Detonate faster and more violently.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTriggeredAbys.name: Abyssal Apparition
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTriggeredAbys.description: Consume a Power Charge when you cast a damaging Spell to trigger an Abyssal Apparition who will also cast that same Spell for you. Does not work with Channelling Spells, Spells with a Cooldown, Triggered Spells, Spells granted by items, or Spells which already consume a Power Charge. This Skill is not directly Supportable.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTriggeredGasC.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Gas Cloud
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTriggeredGasC.description: DNT-UNUSED Creates a Poison cloud. Burning effects or Detonator skills will cause the cloud to explode in a fiery blast. (Wording copied from Toxic Grenade.)

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTrinity.name: Trinity
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTrinity.description: Become attuned to all Elements building up Fire, Cold and Lightning Affinity based off the highest Elemental Damage type dealt by your Hits. Your Elemental Damage is enhanced the more Affinity of any type you have.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTwister.name: Twister
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemTwister.description: Whip up a twister with a flick of your Spear. The twister moves forward erratically, Blinding and repeatedly Hitting enemies within. If a twister touches a Whirlwind from your other skills, it Consumes the Whirlwind to create additional twisters that deal more damage. Passing over Elemental Ground Surfaces or Consuming an elemental Whirlwind will grant twisters extra damage of that element.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemUnearth.name: Unearth
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemUnearth.description: Raise spikes of bone from the earth in front of you, damaging enemies. The bones of Corpses and dead Reviving Minions in the area are ripped out and reassembled into short-lived Bone Construct Minions that fight for you. Larger Corpses create more than one Bone Construct.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemUniqueBreachL.name: Lightning Bolt
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemUniqueBreachL.description: Call down a Shocking bolt of Lightning to strike enemies in a small area.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemUniqueDuskVig.name: Ember Fusillade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemUniqueDuskVig.description: Conjure a blazing Ember that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Ember launches at an enemy, dealing Fire damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Embers. Multiple Embers fired in the same Fusillade will attempt to target different enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to cause the entire Fusillade to create beams that Chain to enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemUniqueEarthbo.name: Spark
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemUniqueEarthbo.description: Launch a spray of sparking Projectiles that travel erratically along the ground until they hit an enemy or expire. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to fire many sparks in a circle.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemVaultingImpac.name: Vaulting Impact
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemVaultingImpac.description: Leap forward and Slam the ground, sending out a shockwave. The shockwave applies Broken Stance to Dazed enemies, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemVineArrow.name: Vine Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemVineArrow.description: Fire an arrow into the air that lands after a short delay, damaging enemies and causing a plant to spring up at the impact location. The plant sprouts vines that latch onto nearby enemies, Slowing their movement speed and dealing Chaos damage over time. The plant can be Poisoned, causing it to deal more damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemVoltaicMark.name: Voltaic Mark
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemVoltaicMark.description: Mark a target, making them more susceptible to being Electrocuted. When the Marked target is Electrocuted, the Mark Activates, granting a Buff which gives extra Lightning damage and Consuming the Mark. Marking another target while you have the Buff will remove the Buff.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWarBanner.name: War Banner
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWarBanner.description: While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Attack damage, Attack speed and Accuracy.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWhirlwindLanc.name: Whirlwind Lance
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWhirlwindLanc.description: Throw a Spear with enough force to kick up a Whirlwind where it lands, Slowing enemies and Blinding them in its area of effect. Entering the Whirlwind collapses it, dealing damage and causing Knockback. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to create the Whirlwind with one more than its normal maximum number of stages.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWildProtector.name: Wild Protector
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWildProtector.description: Call upon a Bear Spirit Companion to maul your foes. The Bear Spirit leaps at enemies to Maim them, Leeches Life with its slam, and periodically roars to Intimidate enemies. The Bear Spirit does not count toward your Companion limit.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWindDancer.name: Wind Dancer
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWindDancer.description: While active, periodically grants stages of a buff that gives you more Evasion per stage. Being Hit by an Enemy while you have this buff consumes all stages to damage and Knock Back enemies around you.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWindSerpentsF.name: Wind Serpent's Fury
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWindSerpentsF.description: Consume all Frenzy Charges to perform a gigantic spear thrust that Knocks Back enemies. For each Frenzy Charge consumed, a Wind Serpent follows in the spear's wake. Each Serpent also damages and Knocks Back enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWingBlast.name: Wing Blast
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWingBlast.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and launch yourself backwards with a powerful wingbeat that Knocks Back enemies. Enemies Primed for Heavy Stun will be stunned, release a shockwave, and have a chance to grant you a Power Charge. This skill can be used while using other skills to interrupt them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWitheringPres.name: Withering Presence
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWitheringPres.description: While active, emits an Aura that periodically Withers enemies in your Presence.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWolfArcticHow.name: Arctic Howl
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWolfArcticHow.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and let out an icy howl that damages enemies and Freezes Primed enemies. If an enemy is Frozen or a Frozen enemy is Hit, this Skill Empowers your attacks with added Cold damage, causes Empowered Slams to create Chilled Ground, and grants your Allies added Cold damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWolfCrossSlas.name: Cross Slash
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWolfCrossSlas.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and leap backwards as you gouge the ground with both claws. Enemies can be Hit separately by both gouges. Hitting a Marked enemy with both gouges will Activate the Mark and cause an additional shockwave. Ice Fragments will be pulled into the location where the gouges cross and explode. immediately. This skill can be used while using other skills to interrupt them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWolfLunarBles.name: Lunar Blessing
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWolfLunarBles.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and offer your Rage to the moon to receive a blessing, gaining bonus Cold damage for yourself and any Wolf Minions you have from Wolf Pack or Predator's Mark. Spends all Rage to extend the Buff's duration. While the Buff is active, your Werewolf Melee Attacks call down Moonbeams on Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWolfShred.name: Shred
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWolfShred.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and lash out with a flurry of claw swipes. The first Attack can dash to faraway enemies and the final Attack Strikes twice. Attacking a Frozen enemy will create Ice Fragments, which are Projectiles that land and explode after a short delay.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWyvernDevour.name: Devour
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWyvernDevour.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and devour a Corpse or Cullable enemy, and additional nearby Corpses. For each enemy or corpse devoured, you regenerate life and gain a Power Charge. If the target is far enough away, you will leap to them and damage nearby enemies where you land. Targeting nearby enemies or corpses will not perform a leap or a Slam.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWyvernFlameBr.name: Flame Breath
Metadata/Items/Gem/SkillGemWyvernFlameBr.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and take to the skies, immolating enemies with a jet of fire. Channelling ends after a short amount of time but can be prolonged by spending Rage. Consumes a Power Charge if possible to Empower the Skill, Gaining extra Lightning damage and spending Rage more slowly.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAbidingHex.name: Abiding Hex
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAbidingHex.description: Supports Curse Skills you cast yourself. Supported Skills will consume Power Charges on use, gaining significant Curse duration if they do. Cannot Support Skills which consume Power Charges.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAblation.name: Sacrificial Offering
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAblation.description: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use, but deal much more damage and have more powerful Buffs in return.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAcrimony.name: Acrimony
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAcrimony.description: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies. Enemies affected by Damage over time from Supported Skills which was not caused by a Damaging Ailment have reduced Life regeneration rate. Only the strongest instance of this Debuff will apply. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAdhere.name: Adhesive Grenades I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAdhere.description: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land, but doing lower damage when they detonate.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAdhereThree.name: Adhesive Grenades III
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAdhereThree.description: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land. Grenades from Supported Skills have longer cooldowns, and a chance to detonate an additional time.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAdhereTwo.name: Adhesive Grenades II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAdhereTwo.description: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAdmixture.name: Admixture
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAdmixture.description: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Bleeding inflicted by those Hits is more effective against Poisoned Enemies, and Poison inflicted by Supported Skills is more effective against Bleeding Enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAdvancingSt.name: Advancing Storm
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAdvancingSt.description: Supports Storm skills, causing them to appear at the user's location and move towards the target location.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAlignment.name: Alignment I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAlignment.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAlignmentTh.name: Alignment III
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAlignmentTh.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction fire additional Projectiles. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAlignmentTw.name: Alignment II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAlignmentTw.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAmanamusTit.name: Amanamu's Tithe
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAmanamusTit.description: Supports Persistent Minion Skills, granting a chance when Supported Minions die for you to gain an Abyssal Monster Modifier.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAmbrosia.name: Ambrosia
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAmbrosia.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of damage as extra Lightning damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAmbrosiaTwo.name: Ambrosia II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAmbrosiaTwo.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of damage as extra Lightning damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAmmoConserv.name: Ammo Conservation I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAmmoConserv.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAmmoConserv.name: Arjun's Medal
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAmmoConserv.description: Supports Crossbow Skills, causing them to load a bolt into all Crossbow Ammunition on kill.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAmmoConserv.name: Ammo Conservation III
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAmmoConserv.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing, at the cost of Reload speed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAmmoConserv.name: Ammo Conservation II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAmmoConserv.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAncestralAi.name: Ancestral Aid
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAncestralAi.description: Supports Strikes you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until you have Blocked a certain number of Hits, but will be Ancestrally Boosted when used. After use, this Blocked Hit counter will reset. Cannot Support Channelled Skills or Skills which already have a Condition for use.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAncestralCa.name: Ancestral Call I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAncestralCa.description: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAncestralCa.name: Ancestral Call III
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAncestralCa.description: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every second, at the cost of a damage penalty. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAncestralCa.name: Ancestral Call II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAncestralCa.description: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAncestralUr.name: Urgent Totems I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAncestralUr.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAncestralUr.name: Urgent Totems III
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAncestralUr.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly. Totems created by Supported Skills have increased Attack and Cast Speed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAncestralUr.name: Urgent Totems II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAncestralUr.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemArakaalisLu.name: Arakaali's Lust
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemArakaalisLu.description: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to deal increasingly higher damage the more Poisons are on the target.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemArbitersIgn.name: Arbiter's Ignition
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemArbitersIgn.description: Supports Fire Spell Skills causing you to gain Elemental Archon when Igniting with them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemArbitersRea.name: Arbiter's Reach
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemArbitersRea.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you periodically grant Guard to allies in your Presence while the Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemArmourExplo.name: Armour Explosion
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemArmourExplo.description: Supports Attacks and Warcries, causing them to trigger a Fiery explosion when they Fully Break an enemy's Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemArmsLength.name: Arms Length
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemArmsLength.description: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies, causing Knockback from those Hits to be significantly more effective.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAstralProje.name: Astral Projection
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAstralProje.description: Supports Nova Skills, causing those Skills to take place at the targeted location when used instead of around you.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAtzirisAllu.name: Atziri's Allure
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAtzirisAllu.description: Supports Curse Spells you cast yourself, causing those Curses to ignore the usual Curse Limit, but be reflected back to you when inflicted.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAtzirisCall.name: Atziri's Call
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAtzirisCall.description: DNT-UNUSED Supports Spells you use yourself which Hit enemies. On Critical Hit with supported Spells, Trigger Atziri's Storm at the location of the nearest enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAtzirisComm.name: Atziri's Communion
