Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAtzirisComm.description: Supports Persistent Skills, making them Reserve Life instead of Spirit. Cannot Support Skills which create Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAtzirisImpa.name: Atziri's Impatience
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAtzirisImpa.description: Supports Skills you use yourself that have Cooldowns, dramatically increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover, but causing you to lose Life, Mana, and Energy Shield when they are used. Cannot Support Meta Skills or Persistent Skills, or modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAutoReload.name: Auto Reload
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemAutoReload.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBarbs.name: Barbs I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBarbs.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBarbsThree.name: Barbs III
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBarbsThree.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage twice to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBarbsTwo.name: Barbs II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBarbsTwo.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBattershout.name: Battershout
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBattershout.description: Supports Warcry Skills. Supported Skills Consume Fully Broken Armour to trigger Physical Damage explosions on Enemies within their range but cannot themselves Break Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBidding.name: Bidding I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBidding.description: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBiddingThre.name: Bidding III
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBiddingThre.description: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions have significantly increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBiddingTwo.name: Bidding II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBiddingTwo.description: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBlindside.name: Blindside
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBlindside.description: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills are more likely to Critically Hit Blinded Enemies, and deal more Damage with Critical Hits against Blinded Enemies, but cannot themselves inflict Blind.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBloodintheE.name: Hobble
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBloodintheE.description: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Hobble Bleeding Enemies based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBoneShrapne.name: Bone Shrapnel
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBoneShrapne.description: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies. Supported Skills trigger Bone Shrapnel explosions when killing Pinned Enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBrambleslam.name: Brambleslam
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBrambleslam.description: Supports Slam Skills, making them Trigger Brambles to create Hazardous brambles which damage and Maim enemies. Does not modify Skills used by Minions or Totems.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBranchingFi.name: Branching Fissures I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBranchingFi.description: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBranchingFi.name: Branching Fissures II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBranchingFi.description: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBreachlords.name: Breachlord's Amalgam
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBreachlords.description: Supports Lightning or Cold skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles and do not already have cooldowns, adding a cooldown and making the Projectiles return, piercing through targets as they do so.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBreachlords.name: Breachlord's Rift
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBreachlords.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Break Armour of enemies it Freezes or Electrocutes.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBreakEndura.name: Break Endurance
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBreakEndura.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when it Fully Breaks an enemy's Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBrink.name: Brink I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBrink.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Heavy Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Heavy Stun.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBrinkTwo.name: Brink II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBrinkTwo.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Stun.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBurgeon.name: Burgeon I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBurgeon.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBurgeonTwo.name: Burgeon II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemBurgeonTwo.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCadence.name: Cadence
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCadence.description: Supports Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills gain more Attack speed each time you use them, but will become unusable if used too frequently in a short time frame. Sustained Skills will instead gain Attack speed periodically while being used.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCaltrops.name: Caltrops
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCaltrops.description: Supports Ranged Spear Attacks. Supported Skills create Caltrops when Projectiles they create reach the end of their flight.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCapacitor.name: Energy Capacitor
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCapacitor.description: Supports Invocation Skills which Trigger other Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCatharsis.name: Catharsis
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCatharsis.description: Supports any Skill you use yourself, causing supported Skill to detonate Volatility that is present on you. Supported Skill can only be used while you have a certain amount of Volatility and cannot support Skills which already have another Condition.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCathasBrill.name: Catha's Brilliance
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCathasBrill.description: Supports skills which create Companions, causing enemies near them to be Blinded and Ignited. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemChaoticFree.name: Chaotic Freeze
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemChaoticFree.description: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time. Enemies taking damage over time from Debuffs caused by supported skills will suffer Freeze build up from Chaos damage Hits from any source. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemChargedShot.name: Charged Shots I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemChargedShot.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills restores a portion of its Mana cost and Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemChargedShot.name: Charged Shots II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemChargedShot.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCharmBounty.name: Charm Bounty
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCharmBounty.description: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Charm charges.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemClash.name: Clash
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemClash.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills deal more Damage while you have a lower percentage of your Life remaining than the target struck, but less Damage when the reverse is true.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCombatReloa.name: Ratha's Assault
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCombatReloa.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load multiple extra bolts and attack faster. Supported Skills cannot reload normally, instead loading bolts when you Dodge.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCommandment.name: Commandment
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCommandment.description: Supports Minions which have Command Skills. Supported Minions have massively increased cooldown recovery speed for Command Skills they use, but deal no damage with non-Command Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCommiserate.name: Commiserate
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCommiserate.description: Supports Skills you use or Trigger yourself, which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills inflict more powerful Ailments if you are afflicted with those Ailments when you inflict them, while also removing from you any Ailment that they inflict.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemConcoct.name: Concoct I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemConcoct.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemConcoctTwo.name: Concoct II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemConcoctTwo.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemConsideredC.name: Considered Casting
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemConsideredC.description: Supports Spell Skills that Hit Enemies and you cast yourself, boosting Damage at the cost of Cast Speed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCoolHeaded.name: Cool Headed
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCoolHeaded.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Ignite applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCorpseConse.name: Corpse Conservation
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCorpseConse.description: Supports skills that consume Corpses, giving them a chance to take effect without destroying the Corpse.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCracklingBa.name: Crackling Barrier
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCracklingBa.description: Supports Channelling Skills. While Channelling Supported Skills, you gain Lightning Thorns based off of your maximum Mana.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCrater.name: Crater
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCrater.description: Supports Melee Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Fissures when you land. Cannot Support Totem Skills, and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCrazedMinio.name: Crazed Minions
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCrazedMinio.description: Supports Minion Skills which summon Reviving Minions. Supported Minions deal significantly more Damage if they have Revived Recently.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCrystalline.name: Crystalline Shards
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCrystalline.description: Supports Skills which create Ice Crystals. Damaging Explosions caused by Ice Crystals from Supported Skills will Impale Enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCullingStri.name: Culling Strike I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCullingStri.description: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCullingStri.name: Culling Strike II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCullingStri.description: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit, and increasing the threshold at which they will Cull Enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCulmination.name: Culmination I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCulmination.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCulmination.name: Culmination II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCulmination.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCursedGroun.name: Cursed Ground
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemCursedGroun.description: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Curse Skills create areas which Curse Enemies so long as they are within them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDanseMacabr.name: Danse Macabre
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDanseMacabr.description: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills have increased Buff effect and deal more damage, but will target an additional skeletal Minion when cast. If there is not an additional skeletal Minion to target, no damage or Buff effect will be granted.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDaressosPas.name: Daresso's Passion
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDaressosPas.description: Supports Banner Skills, causing them to require significantly less Glory to use.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDauntless.name: Dauntless
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDauntless.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills cannot be used unless you have been stationary for a certain duration, but deal increasingly more damage the longer you are stationary. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown or another usage Condition.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDazingCry.name: Dazing Cry
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDazingCry.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to Daze Enemies on use.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDazzle.name: Dazzle
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDazzle.description: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills always hit Dazed Enemies, but Consume Daze on Hit, and cannot themselves inflict Daze. Cannot Support Skills which Consume Daze.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDeadlyResol.name: Deadly Resolve
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDeadlyResol.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself. While Channelling Supported Skills, periodically gain stages of Deadly Resolve. Expend a stage of Deadly Resolve when an enemy Hits you to Trigger a deadly slash towards that enemy, dealing more damage based on your Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDeathmarch.name: Deathmarch
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDeathmarch.description: Supports Skills which create Persistent Minions. Supported Minions will restore Life to nearby Allied Minions on death, as well as removing Ailments from those Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDecayingHex.name: Decaying Hex
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDecayingHex.description: Supports Curse skills. Supported skill Trigger Profane Decay on each target they curse to inflict a damaging Debuff.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDefy.name: Defy I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDefy.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky if you are Surrounded.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDefyTwo.name: Defy II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDefyTwo.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky and Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used if you are Surrounded.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDelayedGrat.name: Delayed Gratification
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDelayedGrat.description: Supports Skills which require some Condition to be met for use. Supported Skills can be used an additional time after their Condition has been met, but meeting that Condition is harder.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDelayedReac.name: Delayed Reaction
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDelayedReac.description: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to only be able to trigger immediately after creation or at the end of their duration. Created Hazards have significantly lowered duration, and deal more damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDeliberatio.name: Deliberation
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDeliberatio.description: Supports skills that can be used while moving, causing you to move slower while using them, but granting more damage in exchange.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDerange.name: Derange
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDerange.description: Supports Skills which you use yourself which can deal damage. Supported Skills gain an Energy Shield cost equal to your Intelligence, while also dealing more non-Ailment Damage over time based off of your Intelligence. Cannot support Channelling Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDesperation.name: Desperation
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDesperation.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used while Surrounded.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDiallasDesi.name: Dialla's Desire
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDiallasDesi.description: Supports any Skill which has levels, increasing the level and Quality, while reducing the cost and Reservation.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDireStrike.name: Direstrike I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDireStrike.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDireStrikeT.name: Direstrike II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDireStrikeT.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDissipate.name: Harmonic Remnants I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDissipate.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDissipateTw.name: Harmonic Remnants II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDissipateTw.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away, with a chance to create an additional Remnant.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDoedresUndo.name: Doedre's Undoing
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDoedresUndo.description: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Skills create an area which Curses Enemies within it, and spawns Witchtoads in that area. Witchtoads leap at enemies that get close, and seek out Cursed enemies with higher aggression. Dark Consequences will be Triggered when they hit enemies with their leap, violently exploding the Witchtoad.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDomain.name: Persistent Ground I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDomain.description: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDomainThree.name: Persistent Ground III
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDomainThree.description: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer as well as lowering the Cooldown Recovery Speed of affected Enemies. Ground Surfaces from Supported Skills only end when their duration expires.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDomainTwo.name: Persistent Ground II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDomainTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer and only end when their duration expires.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDoubleBarre.name: Double Barrel I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDoubleBarre.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDoubleBarre.name: Double Barrel III
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDoubleBarre.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed. Supported Skills will also automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDoubleBarre.name: Double Barrel II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDoubleBarre.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDurability.name: Durability
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemDurability.description: Supports Skills which create objects that are destroyed after being Hit a number of times, allowing for them to last for additional Hits. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemEmbitter.name: Embitter
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemEmbitter.description: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies with Hits, causing all sources of Damage Gained to instead be treated as Damage Gained as extra Cold for Supported Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemEnduringImp.name: Enduring Impact I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemEnduringImp.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemEnduringImp.name: Enduring Impact II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemEnduringImp.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemEnergyReten.name: Energy Retention
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemEnergyReten.description: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills gain a chance to partially Refund a portion of Energy cost when Triggering or Invoking other Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemEnormity.name: Hulking Minions
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemEnormity.description: Supports Skills which summon Persistent Minions. Supported Minions are larger, have more Life, and deal more Damage, but cost significantly more Spirit.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemEshsProwess.name: Esh's Prowess
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemEshsProwess.description: Supports Lightning Skills that Hit, granting them an additional level and causing them to only roll the minimum or maximum value for Lightning damage. Does not Support Skills which do not have levels.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemEshsRadianc.name: Esh's Radiance
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemEshsRadianc.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Shock.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemExcise.name: Excise
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemExcise.description: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to Critically Hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemExcoriate.name: Excoriate
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemExcoriate.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills deal more Melee Damage for each Elemental Ailment on Enemies they hit, but cannot themselves inflict Elemental Ailments.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemExecrate.name: Execrate
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemExecrate.description: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to inflict Ailments on hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemExpanse.name: Expanse
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemExpanse.description: Supports any Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher Area of Effect but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemExpedite.name: Short Fuse I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemExpedite.description: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, shortening the time before Detonation.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemExpediteTwo.name: Short Fuse II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemExpediteTwo.description: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, massively shortening the time before Detonation at the cost of Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemExtraction.name: Extraction
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemExtraction.description: Supports Spell Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Using supported Spells will cause you to Sacrifice a portion of your Life on use, gaining extra Chaos Damage in exchange. Does not support Persistent Skills, Minion Skills, or Triggered Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFerocity.name: Ferocity
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFerocity.description: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Frenzy Charge on use if possible, and will gain significant Skill Speed if they do, but cannot generate Frenzy Charges. Cannot Support Skills which consume Frenzy Charges.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFigurehead.name: Selfless Remnants
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFigurehead.description: Supports Skills that generate Remnants, causing those Remnants to affect Allies in your Presence when collected instead of you.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFirstBlood.name: First Blood
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFirstBlood.description: Supports Attacks. Supported Skills are far more likely to inflict Bleeding on Hitting full Life Enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFlamePillar.name: Flame Pillar
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFlamePillar.description: Supports any Skill you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Ignite on Hit to create pillars of flame, but cannot themselves inflict Ignite. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Ignite, and does not modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFlamepierce.name: Flamepierce
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFlamepierce.description: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Initial Projectile created by Supported Skills will always Pierce Ignited Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Ignite themselves.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFlow.name: Flow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFlow.description: Supports Skills which require Combo to use. Supported Skills lose their Combo stacks after a longer delay spent not gaining any Combo.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFluke.name: Fluke
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFluke.description: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFlukeTwo.name: Ixchel's Torment
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFlukeTwo.description: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage, Area of Effect, and Projectile Speed randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFocusedCurs.name: Focused Curse
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFocusedCurs.description: Supports Curse skills, causing them to Curse enemies more quickly after being cast.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFreezefork.name: Freezefork
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFreezefork.description: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Projectiles from Supported Skills always Fork when the initial Projectile Hits Frozen Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot build up Freeze themselves.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFreshClip.name: Fresh Clip I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFreshClip.description: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 6 seconds.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFreshClipTw.name: Fresh Clip II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFreshClipTw.description: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 8 seconds.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFrozenSpite.name: Frozen Spite
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemFrozenSpite.description: Supports Skills that Hit enemies, causing them to create Ice Fragments on killing Frozen Enemies. Cannot Support Totem Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemGambleshot.name: Gambleshot
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemGambleshot.description: Supports Skills which fire Projectiles that are not ground targeted. Projectiles from Supported Skills randomly Fork, Chain or Pierce.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemGarukhansRe.name: Garukhan's Resolve
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemGarukhansRe.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills have a maximum Critical Hit chance, but will Bifurcate Critical Hit Chance.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemGlacier.name: Glacier
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemGlacier.description: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with higher Life.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemGreatwood.name: Cirel's Cultivation
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemGreatwood.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing you from having more than one of that Totem but granting significant benefits for Supported Totems based how many allied Totems are near them. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemGreatwoodTw.name: Greatwood II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemGreatwoodTw.description: DNT Supports Skills which create Totems, limiting their active Totem count to one but granting significant benefits for supported Totems based how many allied Totems are near them. Does not support Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemGrudge.name: Relentless Rage
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemGrudge.description: Supports Skills you use yourself. On spending Rage with any skill you will gain a Buff. Using Supported Skills consumes this Buff to grant you Rage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemGuatelitzi.name: Guatelitzi's Ablation
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemGuatelitzi.description: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use. While Offering spikes from Supported Skills persist, you are periodically granted a Power Charge. When spikes from Supported Skills die, Regenerate a percentage of your maximum Life and Mana per second based on the duration the Offering persisted.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHaemocrysta.name: Haemocrystals
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHaemocrysta.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Bleeding on Hit to create explosive blood-filled crystals, but cannot themselves inflict Bleeding. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHardyTotems.name: Hardy Totems I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHardyTotems.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHardyTotems.name: Tawhoa's Tending
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHardyTotems.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life. Totems created by Supported Skills explode on death, dealing Physical damage based on their Life.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHardyTotems.name: Hardy Totems II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHardyTotems.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHayoxisFulm.name: Hayoxi's Fulmination
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHayoxisFulm.description: Supports Curse Skills, giving them a short cooldown but causing them to create areas which Curse enemies so long as they are within them. Cursed areas from Supported Skills gather power before erupting in a column of annihilating light after a moderate delay.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHeft.name: Heft
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHeft.description: Supports Skills which deal Damage, increasing the maximum Physical Damage of their Hits.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHelbrymsHid.name: Helbrym's Hide
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHelbrymsHid.description: Supports Shapeshifting Skills, causing them to grant Helbrym's Composure for a brief duration when they cause you to Shapeshift. Shapeshifting into a different form before the Buff expires causes it to be removed without effect.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHerDeclarat.name: Her Declaration
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHerDeclarat.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing enemies that enter your Presence to become Intimidated while the Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHinder.name: Hinder
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHinder.description: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time, causing damage over time they inflict to also Hinder enemies. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHitAndRun.name: Hit and Run
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHitAndRun.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills can only be used after you have moved a certain distance, but have massively increased Skill Speed. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHoarfrost.name: Hoarfrost
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHoarfrost.description: Supports Skills which create Ice Crystals. Supported Skills create chilling areas which deal Cold Damage over time instead of creating Ice Crystals.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHolyDescent.name: Holy Descent
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemHolyDescent.description: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Consecrated Ground when you land.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemIcicle.name: Icicle
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemIcicle.description: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with lower Life.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemImpale.name: Impale
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemImpale.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Impale on Hit but making them unable to Extract Impale themselves.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemImpetus.name: Boundless Energy I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemImpetus.description: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemImpetusTwo.name: Boundless Energy II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemImpetusTwo.description: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemIncision.name: Incision
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemIncision.description: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills inflict Incision on Hit, which causes Enemies to be increasingly more likely to be inflicted with Bleeding. All Incision is removed from a target on inflicting it with Bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemInhibitor.name: Inhibitor
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemInhibitor.description: Supports any Skill you use or Trigger yourself. Supported Skills cannot consume Charges or Infusion by any means. Cannot Support Skills which require Charges or Infusion to be used.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemInnervate.name: Innervate
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemInnervate.description: Supports damaging skills you use yourself. Killing a Shocked enemy with supported skills imbues your damage with Lightning damage for a short time.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemIntenseAgon.name: Intense Agony
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemIntenseAgon.description: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to have a shorter duration but deal substantially more damage over time with Debuffs inflicted against enemies on full life.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemInterlude.name: Remnant Potency I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemInterlude.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemInterludeTh.name: Remnant Potency III
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemInterludeTh.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemInterludeTw.name: Remnant Potency II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemInterludeTw.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemIronGrip.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Iron Grip
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemIronGrip.description: DNT-UNUSED Modifiers to Melee damage also apply to Projectile damage for supported skill

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemIronWill.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Iron Will
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemIronWill.description: DNT-UNUSED Modifiers to Melee damage also apply to Spell damage for supported skill

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemIronwood.name: Reinforced Totems I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemIronwood.description: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemIronwoodTwo.name: Reinforced Totems II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemIronwoodTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemKalisasCres.name: Kalisa's Crescendo
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemKalisasCres.description: Supports Curse Skills. Enemies Cursed by Supported Skills are Pacified for the final portion of the Supported Curse's duration.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemKaomsMadnes.name: Kaom's Madness
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemKaomsMadnes.description: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create many additional fissures at the cost of damage, speed, and area of effect.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemKhatalsReju.name: Khatal's Rejuvenation
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemKhatalsReju.description: Supports Skills that generate Remnants. Picking up Remnants from Supported Skills grants Khatal's Rejuvenation.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemKulemaksDom.name: Kulemak's Dominion
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemKulemaksDom.description: Supports Offering Skills, causing your Cascadable Spells to Cascade to the locations of Supported Offerings.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemKurgalsLeas.name: Kurgal's Leash
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemKurgalsLeas.description: Supports Commandable Minions causing you and the Supported Minion to gain Unholy Might when you Command them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemLastGasp.name: Last Gasp
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemLastGasp.description: Supports Skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a short duration.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemLeverage.name: Leverage
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemLeverage.description: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies. Supported Skills gain increased chance to Critically Hit against Immobilised Enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemLivingLight.name: Living Lightning
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemLivingLight.description: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemLivingLight.name: Living Lightning II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemLivingLight.description: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemLongFuse.name: Long Fuse I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemLongFuse.description: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemLongFuseTwo.name: Long Fuse II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemLongFuseTwo.description: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemLoyalty.name: Loyalty
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemLoyalty.description: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMagnetism.name: Magnetic Remnants
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMagnetism.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMalady.name: Malady
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMalady.description: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits, causing base chance to inflict Bleeding with Supported Skills to instead apply to base chance to Poison, and causing base chance to Poison to instead apply to Bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMedvedsFell.name: Medved's Felling
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMedvedsFell.description: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself, causing them to attack faster the more Rage you have and grant Rage on Hit, but also making you lose Life based on your Rage when using them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMinionInsta.name: Minion Instability
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMinionInsta.description: Supports skills which create Minions, causing them to violently explode when reduced to Low Life.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMinionPact.name: Minion Pact I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMinionPact.description: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMinionPactT.name: Minion Pact II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMinionPactT.description: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMorganasTem.name: Morgana's Tempest
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMorganasTem.description: Supports Storm skills, increasing their Limit and causing them to move quickly from the user to the target location, but become less effective. Cannot Support Triggered Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMorrigansIn.name: Mórrigan's Insight
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMorrigansIn.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage and trigger Nature's Exchange when consuming Freeze on enemies. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMuster.name: Muster
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMuster.description: Supports Skills which summon Minions. Supported Minions deal more Damage the more different kinds of Reviving Minions you have summoned.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMysticism.name: Mysticism I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMysticism.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMysticismTw.name: Mysticism II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemMysticismTw.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemNadir.name: Nadir
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemNadir.description: DNT-UNUSED Supports Skills which gain Stages or Seals. Supported Skills have lower Maximum Stage or Seal count, but have a Minimum Stage or Seal count they cannot fall below.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemNimbleReloa.name: Nimble Reload
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemNimbleReloa.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to Reload bolts significantly faster.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemOutmaneuver.name: Outmaneuver
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemOutmaneuver.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Break Armour against Parried Enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemOverextend.name: Overextend
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemOverextend.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills deal more Damage with Critical Hits, but Critically Hitting an Enemy with them will Daze you for a short time.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPayload.name: Payload
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPayload.description: Supports Skills which fire Grenades, giving fired Grenades a chance to activate again, but lengthening their cooldowns.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPerfectedEn.name: Perfected Endurance
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPerfectedEn.description: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfect Timing. Supported Skills grant at least one Endurance Charge when Hitting an enemy with Perfect Timing.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPerfection.name: Perfection
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPerfection.description: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Perfection, which is a powerful damage buff. However, failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Perfection) will remove all Perfection on you.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPietysMercy.name: Dominus' Grasp
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPietysMercy.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain more times.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPoisonSpore.name: Poison Spores
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPoisonSpore.description: Supports Plant Skills which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Trigger Toxic Pustule on Hitting an enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPotential.name: Potential
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPotential.description: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Power Charge on use if possible, and will be much more likely to Critically Hit if they do. Supported Skills cannot generate Power Charges. Cannot Support Skills which consume Power Charges.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPracticedCo.name: Practiced Combo
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPracticedCo.description: Supports Strike Skills. Supported Skills have a chance to build additional Combo on Hit. Cannot support Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemProfanity.name: Profanity I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemProfanity.description: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume a Corpse on use, dealing more Chaos Damage if they do.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemProfanityTw.name: Profanity II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemProfanityTw.description: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume many Corpses on use, dealing more Chaos Damage per Corpse consumed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPrototypeSe.name: Prototype Seventeen
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPrototypeSe.description: Supports non-Channelling skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to gain Critical Hit chance based on Rage, but also remove all Rage upon Critically Hitting.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPunchThroug.name: Punch Through
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPunchThroug.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills apply Easy Target when Knocking Back Enemies, causing the next Projectile Attack Hit they take to deal increased Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPursuit.name: Pursuit I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPursuit.description: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPursuitThre.name: Pursuit III
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPursuitThre.description: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPursuitTwo.name: Pursuit II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemPursuitTwo.description: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemQuillBurst.name: Quill Burst
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemQuillBurst.description:
Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills trigger Quill Burst, which deals your Thorns Damage in an Area around the target struck. Quill Burst can only be triggered on Hit after you've
Retaliated with Thorns Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRageforged.name: Rageforged I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRageforged.description: Supports any damaging skill that you use or Trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRageforgedT.name: Rageforged II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRageforgedT.description: Supports any damaging skill that you use or Trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage, with a chance to skip spending Rage while still benefitting as though it had. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRagingCry.name: Raging Cry
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRagingCry.description: Supports Warcry skills, causing them to grant you Rage on use depending on counted monster Power.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRakiatasFlo.name: Rakiata's Flow
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRakiatasFlo.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, causing those Hits to treat Enemy Elemental Resistances as inverted.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRally.name: Rally
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRally.description: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills Consume all Endurance Charge on use, causing you to restore a percentage of your maximum Life for each Charge Consumed. Cannot Support Skills which consume Endurance Charges.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemReach.name: Overreach
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemReach.description: Supports Attack Skills which deal Damage in an Area. Supported Skills have significantly increased Area of Effect, but are less Accurate against nearby targets.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRearm.name: Rearm I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRearm.description: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRearmTwo.name: Rearm II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRearmTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRefraction.name: Refraction I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRefraction.description: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which grants Deflection Rating and causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRefractionT.name: Refraction III
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRefractionT.description: Supports Banner Skills, causing Enemies within their area to gain Refractive Dissolution, a Debuff which lowers Elemental Resistances.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRefractionT.name: Refraction II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRefractionT.description: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which grants Deflection Rating and causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRetaliate.name: Retaliate I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRetaliate.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRetaliateTw.name: Retaliate II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRetaliateTw.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage and are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRetort.name: Frenzied Riposte
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRetort.description: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to Consume the Parried Debuff on Hit to grant you a Frenzy Charge. Cannot support Skills which already Consume the Parried Debuff.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRetreat.name: Retreat I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRetreat.description: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRetreatThre.name: Retreat III
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRetreatThre.description: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRetreatTwo.name: Retreat II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRetreatTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemReverberate.name: Reverberate
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemReverberate.description: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills that have a chance to Aftershock have increased chance to cause Aftershocks the longer their Attack time.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRicochet.name: Ricochet I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRicochet.description: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRicochetThr.name: Ricochet III
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRicochetThr.description: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, causing those Projectiles to Chain when impacting terrain, at the cost of any additional Projectiles, as well as causing them to always Pierce.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRicochetTwo.name: Ricochet II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRicochetTwo.description: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRigwaldsFer.name: Rigwald's Ferocity
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRigwaldsFer.description: Supports Attack skills, granting them Attack Speed at the cost of Damage or Damage at the cost of Attack Speed depending on Weapon Set they are used in. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRime.name: Rime
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRime.description: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing Enemies Chilled by those Surfaces to be more easily Frozen, but at the cost of some Chill magnitude.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRip.name: Rip
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRip.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use or Trigger yourself. Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies create a Blood Remnant. Blood Remnants increase your Life regeneration rate for a short while after being collected.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRitualistic.name: Ritualistic Curse
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRitualistic.description: Supports Curse skills, causing them to cover a larger area but take longer to Curse enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRomirasRequ.name: Romira's Requital
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRomirasRequ.description: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life. A percentage of Damage taken this way is Recouped by you as Life.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRupture.name: Rupture
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRupture.description: Supports skills that Hit Enemies. Supported skills Aggravate Bleeding on Hitting Heavily Stunned Enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRustedSpike.name: Rusted Spikes
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemRustedSpike.description: Supports Skills which deal Damage with Hits. When Supported Skills Pin an Enemy, they also Aggravate Bleeding on that Enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSacrificial.name: Sacrificial Lamb I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSacrificial.description: Supports Skills which create Minions, causing your Skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill before your other Minions where possible.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSacrificial.name: Sacrificial Lamb II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSacrificial.description: Supports Skills which create Minions, causing your Skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill before your other Minions where possible, as well as causing them to always be considered Detonatable.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSalvo.name: Salvo
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSalvo.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when used, causing additional Projectiles to be fired. Projectiles from Supported Skills are fired in random directions. Cannot Support Skills which require Combo, have a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSeeRed.name: See Red
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSeeRed.description: Supports Attack Skills. Bleeding inflicted with Supported Skills lasts significantly longer, but enemies you inflict Bleeding onto with Supported Skills will move and Attack faster.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSeraphsHear.name: Seraph's Heart
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSeraphsHear.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, providing a chance for enemies to calculate their Hits as though your Resistances were 90% while the skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemShockingLea.name: Shocking Leap
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemShockingLea.description: Supports Skills that leap into the air and deal damage, causing them to create Shocked Ground the first time they Critically Hit an enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemShockingRif.name: Electromagnetism
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemShockingRif.description: Supports Skills that Hit enemies. When Supported Skills Shock an enemy that is nearby other Shocked enemies, trigger Electromagnetism, sucking in nearby enemies, Hindering them, and dealing Lightning damage at an interval.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSingleOut.name: Mark for Death
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSingleOut.description: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSingleOutTw.name: Mark for Death II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSingleOutTw.description: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSkitteringS.name: Skittering Stone I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSkitteringS.description: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSkitteringS.name: Skittering Stone II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSkitteringS.description: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSoulbreaker.name: Soulbreaker
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSoulbreaker.description: Supports skills you use yourself, causing them to Trigger a Chaos Damage nova when breaking Enemy Energy Shield.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSpar.name: Spar
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSpar.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSpectralVol.name: Spectral Volley
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSpectralVol.description: Supports Bow or Spear Projectile Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills deal lower damage initially, but generate Spectral Projectiles, which deal more damage when they fire. Spectral Projectiles linger and will fire a short duration after no new Spectral Projectiles have been created. Cannot support Channelling Skills, Leaping skills, or skills which rain Projectiles from above.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSpellCascad.name: Spell Cascade
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSpellCascad.description: Supports Cascadable Spells, causing them to Cascade to either side of the target area, along a randomly chosen axis.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSplintering.name: Splinter Totem I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSplintering.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSplintering.name: Splinter Totem II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSplintering.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStaticShock.name: Static Shocks
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStaticShock.description: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Hits from Supported Skills Triggers Static Shocks, causing that enemy to become a source of Lightning damage sending pulses towards nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSteadfast.name: Steadfast I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSteadfast.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold while Channelling them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSteadfastTw.name: Steadfast II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSteadfastTw.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold and Ailment Threshold  while Channelling them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStoicism.name: Stoicism I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStoicism.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStoicismTwo.name: Stoicism II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStoicismTwo.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStompingGro.name: Stomping Ground
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStompingGro.description: Supports Travel skills, causing your footsteps to crack the earth and emit damaging shockwaves while using the skill.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStormchain.name: Stormchain
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStormchain.description: Supports Projectile Skills and Skills which can Chain. Supported Skills always Chain when initially Hitting a Shocked Enemy, but cannot themselves inflict Shock. Does not support Skills which cannot Chain.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStreamlined.name: Streamlined Rounds
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStreamlined.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Attack speed and bolt capacity, but deal less damage and have longer reload time.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStripAway.name: Potent Exposure
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStripAway.description: Supports Skills which apply Exposure to Enemies, increasing the effect of applied Exposure.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStrongHeart.name: Strong Hearted
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStrongHeart.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Shock applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStyrnsFeroc.name: Styrn's Ferocity
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStyrnsFeroc.description: Supports Shield Skills that Hit, causing those Hits to Crush their targets, and Physical Hits against those targets while Crushed to Break their Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStyrnsMount.name: Styrn's Mountain
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemStyrnsMount.description: Supports Skills that Raise your Shield causing your other melee skills to deal more damage if you block.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSuffuse.name: Encroaching Ground
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSuffuse.description: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those Surfaces to grow over time, up to a limit.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSwiftAfflic.name: Swift Affliction I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSwiftAfflic.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSwiftAfflic.name: Swift Affliction III
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSwiftAfflic.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing effects with a duration of one second or less to deal more non-Ailment damage over time.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSwiftAfflic.name: Swift Affliction II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSwiftAfflic.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSyzygy.name: Syzygy
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemSyzygy.description: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Hits from Supported Skills are considered Crushing Blows against Enemies which are both Ignited and Fully Armour Broken. Hits with Supported Skills that Heavily Stun Ignited and Fully Armour Broken Enemies will Intimidate them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTacatisIre.name: Tacati's Ire
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTacatisIre.description: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Poison inflicted with Supported Skills deals Damage faster the higher your Rage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTangmazusTh.name: Tangmazu's Thurible
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTangmazusTh.description: Supports Skills which summon Companions causing them to be Gigantic and gain Evasion and Deflection based on your own.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTasaliosRhy.name: Tasalio's Rhythm
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTasaliosRhy.description: Supports Skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Tasalio's Rhythm. Tasalio's Rhythm causes Supported Skills to deal more damage and have shorter Perfect Timing windows for each stack. Failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Tasalio's Rhythm) will remove all Tasalio's Rhythm on you.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTear.name: Tear
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTear.description: Supports Melee Attacks you use or Trigger yourself. On-Kill effects caused by Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies have a chance to occur twice.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTecrodsReve.name: Tecrod's Revenge
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTecrodsReve.description: Supports Skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a duration. Minions from Supported Skills gain Soul Eater and a burst of speed on entering this state.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTekarusSnar.name: [DNT] Tekaru's Snare
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTekarusSnar.description: DNT Supports Mark Skills. Trigger Savage Snare when you Mark enemies with Supported Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemThornskin.name: Thornskin I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemThornskin.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemThornskinTw.name: Thornskin II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemThornskinTw.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTireless.name: Tireless
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTireless.description: Supports Warcry Skills. Attacks Empowered by Supported Skills have a chance not to lower the Empowerment count of Supported Skills when they are used.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTitanicArro.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Titanic Arrows
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTitanicArro.description: DNT-UNUSED Supports Bow Attacks which impact the ground, triggering stunning novas when they do.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTremors.name: Tremors
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTremors.description: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain multiple independent chances to cause Aftershocks, but deal less Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTrickstersS.name: Trickster's Shard
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTrickstersS.description: Supports non-instant Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells will Trigger Fragment Self, creating a Fractured Mimic which will cast that Spell if you get enough of them.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTulsAvalanc.name: Tul's Avalanche
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTulsAvalanc.description: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them when you Block, The Seals are broken when used, each making the Spell Echo. Cannot support skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTulsStillne.name: Tul's Stillness
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTulsStillne.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Freeze Buildup.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTumult.name: Tumult
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTumult.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills consume a Frenzy Charge on use to powerfully Break Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTwofold.name: Heightened Charges
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemTwofold.description: Supports any Skill that Consumes Charges, granting a chance for benefits of that Consumption to be doubled.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUhtredsAugu.name: Uhtred's Augury
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUhtredsAugu.description: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly two other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUhtredsCons.name: Uhtred's Constellation
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUhtredsCons.description: Supports non-instant skills which have a cooldown, granting them two additional cooldown uses and more damage per different skill with a cooldown you have used recently.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUhtredsExod.name: Uhtred's Exodus
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUhtredsExod.description: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them many additional levels provided no other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUhtredsOmen.name: Uhtred's Omen
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUhtredsOmen.description: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly one other support is used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUhtredsRite.name: Uhtred's Rite
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUhtredsRite.description: Supports skills with Cooldowns, causing them to grant Overflowing Chalice when used. Supported skills deal more damage during the effect of your Life Flask and have increased Mana Cost Efficiency during the effect of your Mana Flask.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUnabating.name: Unabating
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUnabating.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Armour, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUnbending.name: Unbending
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUnbending.description: Supports Spell Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, a percentage of Damage taken is Recouped as Mana, with the percentage scaling higher the longer the Cast time of the Supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUndermine.name: Undermine
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUndermine.description: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills Consume Maim on hit, Breaking a percentage of the Maimed target's Armour in doing so. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Maim.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUnerringPow.name: Unerring Power
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUnerringPow.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. When Supported Attacks are Empowered, they have significantly lowered cost and raised Accuracy.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUnsteadyTem.name: Unsteady Tempo
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUnsteadyTem.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Attacking with Supported Skills will cycle through various effects, with the first Attack in sequence inflicting Hobble on you. The second and third Attacks in sequence will powerfully scale chance to Critically Hit and overall damage, respectively, at which point the cycle will reset. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUntouchable.name: Untouchable
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUntouchable.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Evasion Rating, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUnyielding.name: Unyielding
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUnyielding.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, a percentage of Damage taken is Recouped as Life, with the percentage scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the Supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUpheaval.name: Upheaval I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUpheaval.description: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create an additional fissure at the cost of damage and speed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUpheavalTwo.name: Upheaval II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUpheavalTwo.description: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional fissures at the cost of damage and speed.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUpwelling.name: Upwelling I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUpwelling.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUpwellingTw.name: Upwelling II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUpwellingTw.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUulNetolsEm.name: Uul-Netol's Embrace
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemUulNetolsEm.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Break Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVanguard.name: Vanguard I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVanguard.description: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVanguardTwo.name: Vanguard II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVanguardTwo.description: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVarashtasBl.name: Varashta's Blessing
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVarashtasBl.description: Supports any Skill that can deal damage, causing it to deal more damage for each different Command Skill you have used in the past few seconds. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVerglas.name: Verglas
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVerglas.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can Hit Enemies. Supported Skills Gain a percentage of their Damage as Cold Damage when you destroy Ice Crystals.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVolatilePow.name: Volatile Power
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVolatilePow.description: Supports Skills which you use yourself. On using Supported Skills while they are Empowered, you gain Volatility.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVolatility.name: Volatility
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVolatility.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills grant Volatility on Critical Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVolcanicEru.name: Volcanic Eruption
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVolcanicEru.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills trigger Volcanic Eruption on Hit against Ignited Enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVolt.name: Volt
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVolt.description: Supports Projectile Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain Voltaic Charge as you move, up to a maximum. When used, Supported Skills expend that Charge to gain extra Lightning Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVoranasSieg.name: Vorana's Siege
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVoranasSieg.description: Supports skills which Hit targets and have an area of effect, increasing the affected area and causing it to Hit Isolated targets harder.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVruunsAfter.name: Vruun's Aftermath
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVruunsAfter.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to destroy Ice Crystals and Ice Fragments. Supported Skills empower additional Attacks if they destroy enough Ice Crystals and Ice Fragments.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVruunsInevi.name: Vruun's Inevitability
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemVruunsInevi.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills expend their Combo when used, gaining more area of effect the higher Combo they had. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemWarmBlooded.name: Warm Blooded
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemWarmBlooded.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Freeze applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemWildshards.name: Wildshards I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemWildshards.description: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemWildshardsT.name: Sione's Temper
