Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemWildshardsT.description: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have an increasingly higher chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle, resetting when they do.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemWildshardsT.name: Wildshards II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemWildshardsT.description: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemXibaquasRen.name: Xibaqua's Rending
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemXibaquasRen.description: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing Corpses in the area you land to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemXophsPyre.name: Xoph's Pyre
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemXophsPyre.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Ignites.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemZarokhsRefr.name: Zarokh's Refrain
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemZarokhsRefr.description: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells Echo thrice, but are given a Cooldown. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemZenith.name: Zenith I
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemZenith.description: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage while you are above 90% of your Maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemZenithTwo.name: Zenith II
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemZenithTwo.description: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills have increased Mana cost Efficiency and deal more damage while you are above 90% of your maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemZerphisLega.name: Zerphi's Infamy
Metadata/Items/Gem/SupportGemZerphisLega.description:
Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Supported Skills gain a Glory requirement, and build Glory when you spend Life on Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage and have significantly
 increased area of effect.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAbyssalPact.name: Abyssal Pact
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAbyssalPact.description: Sacrifice some of a damageable Minion's life to deal Physical damage in an area around it.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralWar.name: Ancestral Warrior Totem
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralWar.description: Consume 3 Endurance Charges to Raise a Totem that conjures spirit warriors. Each warrior uses a socketed Mace Skill once, then disappears. Cannot use Channelling Skills or Skills with Cooldowns.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncientGifts.name: Wildwood's Gifts
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncientGifts.description: You are chosen by Azmerian spirits who provide guidance, allowing you to see nearby Ancient Blooms.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAnimusExchan.name: Animus Exchange
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAnimusExchan.description: Sacrifice a portion of your Life to recover Runic Ward. Runic Ward recovered by this Skill can Overflow.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAnimusSplint.name: Animus Splinters
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAnimusSplint.description: Expend a large amount of Runic Ward to instantly create a short-lived copy of yourself that uses a Socketed Skill once, then vanishes. This Skill's cost is equal to the total cost of Socketed Skills. The copy cannot perform Channelled, Remote, Cooldown or Conditional Skills, or summon Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArc.name: Arc
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArc.description: An arc of Lightning stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and Chains on to other nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to deal more damage and Chain further.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArchonOfChay.name: Archon of Chayula
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArchonOfChay.description: Build Glory by dealing Chaos damage to enemies. When you have maximum Glory, you can entreat the Dreamer to inhabit you, briefly becoming his Archon.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArcticArmour.name: Arctic Armour
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArcticArmour.description: While active, conjures an icy barrier that gains stages over time. While the barrier has stages, Melee Attacks that hit you will remove a stage to cause a burst of ice that deals Cold Spell damage to the attacker.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArmourBreake.name: Armour Breaker
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArmourBreake.description: Strike with a forceful blow, knocking enemies back and weakening their Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArtilleryBal.name: Siege Ballista
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArtilleryBal.description: Deploy a Ballista Totem that fires bolts skyward, to explode a short time after landing.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyAp.name: Apocalypse
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyAp.description: Build Glory by Hitting enemies with Elemental damage. When you have maximum Glory, you may become the walking Apocalypse for a duration, Triggering one of multiple powerful Elemental Skills at an interval while this Buff lasts.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancySu.name: Supporting Fire
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancySu.description: Recruit artillery Minions that take up positions behind you. They will lie in wait for your Command, then fire volleys of arrows at the target location.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyVi.name: Virtuous Barrier
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyVi.description: While active, conjures a glittering barrier that accumulates protective gemstone Motes of each Attribute type over time, but loses a random Mote when you are Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeChop.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Axe Chop
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeChop.description: DNT-UNUSED Bring your axe down in a sweeping slash, creating a slash along a line in the ground, with a chance to cause bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeExecute.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Axe Execute
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeExecute.description: DNT-UNUSED Perform a heavy melee attack, dealing massive damage to enemies on low life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeHeavyClea.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Axe Heavy Cleave
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeHeavyClea.description: DNT-UNUSED Ready your axe as it charges with flame, then swing in a massive flaming arc, sending out a slow wave of fire.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeLeapingCh.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Axe Leaping Chop
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeLeapingCh.description: DNT-UNUSED Leap forward, dealing massive damage at the end of the attack.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeRaisedCho.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Axe Raised Chop
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeRaisedCho.description: DNT-UNUSED Raise your weapon and channel rage into it, before slashing downwards and dealing massive damage to enemies the path of the attack.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeSlash.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Axe Slash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeSlash.description: DNT-UNUSED Step forward and swing your axe, knocking enemies back to drag them with your attack.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeWhirlingS.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Axe Whirling Slash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAxeWhirlingS.description: DNT-UNUSED Ready your axe then spin, dealing high damage to enemies and causing them to bleed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAzmerianSwar.name: Azmerian Swarms
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAzmerianSwar.description: While active, summons short-lived Azmerian Swarms when you kill enemies affected by Elemental Ailments or hit Rare or Unique enemies affected by Elemental Ailments. The swarms are untargetable Minions that pursue nearby enemies to Attack them and inflict Faerie Fire on Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAzmerianWolf.name: Azmerian Wolf
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAzmerianWolf.description: Summons an ancient Reviving Azmerian Wolf that can howl, calling to spirits convening an Eternal Hunt on Command. It Maims when attacking foes, and can lunge to bite and inflict Bleeding, or howl to inspire nearby allies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBallLightnin.name: Ball Lightning
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBallLightnin.description: Fire a slow-moving Projectile that moves through enemies. The Projectile itself does not Hit enemies, but repeatedly discharges bolts of Lightning at nearby enemies. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to slow down over time, create Ignited Ground as it travels, and explode dealing Fire damage in an Area after it dissipates.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarrage.name: Barrage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarrage.description: Ready a volley of arrows or spears, Empowering your next Repeatable Bow or Projectile Spear Attack to Repeat multiple times. Consumes your Frenzy Charges on use to add additional repeats.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarrierInvoc.name: Barrier Invocation
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarrierInvoc.description: While active, gains Energy when your Energy Shield is damaged by Enemy Hits. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearMaul.name: Maul
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearMaul.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and rake enemies with your claws, generating Rage on Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearRampage.name: Rampage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearRampage.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and charge forward, Slamming the ground as you run. Channelling ends after a short amount of time but can be prolonged by spending Rage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBindSpectre.name: Bind Spectre
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBindSpectre.description: Capture the spirit of a defeated monster, transforming this gem to instead allow you to summon the monster's ghost as a Reviving Minion.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBitterDead.name: Bitter Dead
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBitterDead.description: Spend Ward and target an area, transforming Corpses into bitter cores that seek out enemies and Chill enemies near them. The cores explode at the end of their duration, creating runes which deal additional Cold damage over time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBladeDance.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Blade Dance
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBladeDance.description: DNT-UNUSED Perform a slashing attack that moves you through the battlefield, slicing all around you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBladeNova.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Blade Nova
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBladeNova.description: Fire an arc of knives in front of the caster which deals physical damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlasphemy.name: Blasphemy
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlasphemy.description: Turn socketed Curse skills into vile Auras, applying their effects to all nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodHunt.name: Blood Hunt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodHunt.description: Lunge at a target and skewers them. Hitting an enemy that has suffered Blood Loss will cause a blood explosion and also Consume Bleeding. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneOffering.name: Bone Offering
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneOffering.description: Impale a Skeleton on a bone spike to shield your Minions while the spike remains, reducing the amount of damage taken from Hits. Taking a Hit that deals damage above a certain threshold will cause that Minion's shield to absorb all damage from that Hit, then explode.  The bone spike is itself a Minion, and shields itself. If it dies, shields on your other Minions disappear.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneshatter.name: Boneshatter
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneshatter.description: Attack enemies with a melee Strike. The Strike will cause a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. Upon causing a Heavy Stun it will also create a Shockwave, dealing a large amount of damage in an area.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBriarpatch.name: Briarpatch
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBriarpatch.description: While active, a portion of the Physical Attack damage you deal is stored. Casting a Spell uses the stored damage to create a patch of Thorny Ground that deals Spell damage to moving enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastCurseOnB.name: Curse on Block
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastCurseOnB.description: While active, gains Energy when you Block and triggers socketed Curses on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnBlock.name: Cast on Block
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnBlock.description: While active, gains Energy when you Block and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnCharmU.name: Cast on Charm Use
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnCharmU.description: While active, gains Energy when one of your Charms is used and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnCritic.name: Cast on Critical
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnCritic.description: While active, gains Energy when you Critically Hit enemies and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnDodge.name: Cast on Dodge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnDodge.description: While active, gains Energy when you dodge roll and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnElemen.name: Cast on Elemental Ailment
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnElemen.description: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock, or Ignite enemies, and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnFreeze.name: Cast on Freeze
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnFreeze.description: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze enemies and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnIgnite.name: Cast on Ignite
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnIgnite.description: While active, gains Energy when you Ignite enemies and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMeleeK.name: Cast on Melee Kill
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMeleeK.description: While active, gains Energy when you kill enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMeleeS.name: Cast on Melee Stun
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMeleeS.description: While active, gains Energy when you Stun enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMinion.name: Cast on Minion Death
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMinion.description: While active, gains Energy when one of your Persistent Minions is Killed, and triggers socketed Spells upon reaching maximum Energy. Very underlevelled Minions will incur an Energy generation penalty. Cannot socket Spells which create Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnShock.name: Cast on Shock
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnShock.description: While active, gains Energy when you Shock enemies and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastWhenDama.name: Cast when Damage Taken
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastWhenDama.description: While active, gains Energy when you take damage and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastWhenStun.name: Cast when Stunned
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastWhenStun.description: While active, gains Energy when you are Stunned and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastWhileCha.name: Cast while Channelling
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastWhileCha.description: While active, gains Energy while you're channelling a skill and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChaosbolt.name: Chaos Bolt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChaosbolt.description: Fire a burst of Chaos energy at the target.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargedStaff.name: Charged Staff
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargedStaff.description: Consume all Power Charges to charge your Quarterstaff with electricity, adding Lightning damage and a Lightning shockwave to your Quarterstaff Attacks. Reusing this skill while the Buff is active adds to the Buff's duration and damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemClawRake.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Claw Rake
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemClawRake.description: DNT-UNUSED Perform two upwards slashes, causing massive claw marks in the ground.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCoilingBolts.name: Coiling Bolts
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCoilingBolts.description: Simultaneously fires a Physical Projectile and a Chaos Projectile at the target. These projectiles Chain through any number of Cursed targets.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemComet.name: Comet
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemComet.description: Call down a mass of ice from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to cause a devastating blast of ice and fire.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConductiveRu.name: Conductive Runes
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConductiveRu.description: Spend Runic Ward to create a number of Hazardous Runes in a cone in front of you, which arm after a time. After arming, these Runes will activate when enemies step on them, exploding to deal Attack damage that is not based on your Weapon's damage and apply Electrocution buildup.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConductivity.name: Conductivity
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConductivity.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Lightning Resistance.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemContagion.name: Contagion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemContagion.description: Afflict a single enemy with a Debuff that deals Chaos damage over time. If the enemy dies while affected by Contagion, it spreads itself, Curses, and other Chaos damage over time Debuffs on the target to nearby enemies. This refreshes their durations. Reanimating or detonating a corpse affected by Contagion will cause the Minion or explosion to spread Contagion on hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCorpseCloud.name: Decompose
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCorpseCloud.description: Consume a Corpse to create a cloud of flammable Poisonous gas. Any Burning effects or Detonator skills will explode the gas cloud, creating a fiery explosion.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCorpsewadeCo.name: Decompose
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCorpsewadeCo.description: Consume a Corpse to create a cloud of flammable Poisonous gas. Any Burning effects or Detonator skills will explode the gas cloud, creating a fiery explosion.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCracklingPal.name: Crackling Palm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCracklingPal.description: When you Hit with Unarmed Melee Attacks, calls down lightning bolts which deal Unarmed Attack damage to all surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrushingEart.name: [DNT] Crushing Earth
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrushingEart.description: DNT Convene the surrounding earth into an immense boulder to crash down, dealing high damage at the targeted location after a short delay.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrushingFear.name: Crushing Fear
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrushingFear.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, Culling enemies if their life is low enough. When this skill kills an enemy you draw out their final fears, crushing them to create a shockwave. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDarkPact.name: Dark Pact
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDarkPact.description: Sacrifice the life of a Minion to deal Chaos damage in an area around it. If you have no Minions, your own life is sacrificed instead.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDarkTempest.name: His Dark Horizon
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDarkTempest.description: DNT-UNUSED Create a storm of deathly energies that Empowers your Mana-costing Spells with Cold damage while you remain inside it. Maintaining the storm constantly drains your Mana, and spending more causes it to drain faster. As the storm persists it creates slowly expanding Chilled Ground. Enemies that enter the eye of the storm are Blinded. When you leave the storm, or run out of Mana, the storm ends and unleashes a death-wave, damaging enemies on the Chilled Ground.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDemonMagus.name: Demon Magus
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDemonMagus.description: Activate to summon a Reviving Demon Magus which casts socketed Spells in order.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDespair.name: Despair
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDespair.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Chaos Resistance.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonateDead.name: Detonate Dead
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonateDead.description: Cause a Corpse to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonateLivi.name: Detonate Living
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonateLivi.description: Spend Runic Ward to cause a destabilising Hit against an enemy under the Culling Strike Threshold, making them violently explode. Highlights enemies under the Culling Strike Threshold.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDiscipline.name: Discipline
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDiscipline.description: Emit an Aura that grants you and Allies in your Presence additional Total Energy Shield.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDisengage.name: Disengage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDisengage.description: Jump back as you rupture the earth in front of you with spearpoints, damaging enemies. Consumes the Parried Debuff on Hitting enemies to release a shockwave and grant you a Frenzy Charge. This skill can be used while using other skills, and causes Strikes and Projectiles to miss you while jumping. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEarthquake.name: Earthquake
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEarthquake.description: Smash the ground, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind Jagged Ground that slows enemies. The Jagged Ground erupts in a powerful Aftershock after a duration. Cannot create Jagged Ground on top of an existing patch, or if you already have the maximum number of active patches.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEarthshatter.name: Earthshatter
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEarthshatter.description: Slam the ground, sending out a fissure that deals area damage to enemies it passes under and thrusts a spike from the ground when it ends. Warcries performed near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEmberFusilla.name: Ember Fusillade
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEmberFusilla.description: Conjure a blazing Ember that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Ember launches at an enemy, dealing Fire damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Embers. Multiple Embers fired in the same Fusillade will attempt to target different enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to cause the entire Fusillade to create beams that Chain to enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnervatingNo.name: Enervating Nova
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnervatingNo.description: Unleash a Nova of Lightning damage to Electrocute enemies. Enemies close to you take no damage while enemies at the edge of the ring take significantly more damage. Enemies Hit can be Electrocuted by all Lightning damage for a short duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnfeeble.name: Enfeeble
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnfeeble.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, making them deal less damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEscapeShot.name: Escape Shot
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEscapeShot.description: Leap backwards, firing an icy arrow which can Chill or Freeze enemies around the location from which you escaped. This arrow will create Ice Fragments on impact.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEssenceDrain.name: Essence Drain
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEssenceDrain.description: Fire a Projectile that applies a powerful Chaos damage over time debuff to enemies it hits.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEternalMarch.name: Eternal March
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEternalMarch.description: Spend Runic Ward to instantly Revive your Minions. Prioritises the most powerful minions first.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEternalRage.name: Eternal Rage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEternalRage.description: While active, you constantly regenerate Rage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEvasiveStrik.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Evasive Strike
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEvasiveStrik.description: DNT-UNUSED Leap back before dashing forward, taking out enemies in a path.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveTra.name: Explosive Transmutation
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveTra.description: While active, picking up Remnants Triggers a deadly explosion, dealing damage at the location of the Remnant based on the type of Remnant picked up.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExsanguinate.name: Exsanguinate
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExsanguinate.description: Expel your own blood as Chaining blood tendrils in a cone in front of you. Enemies Hit by the tendrils take Physical damage and are inflicted with Bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEyeOfWinter.name: Eye of Winter
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEyeOfWinter.description: Fire a single Eye Projectile which does not Hit enemies. The Eye constantly releases damaging shard Projectiles in a spiral as it flies. If the Eye passes over an Elemental Ground Surface or Orb, it will take on that surface's effect causing shards to deal more damage of the corresponding Type.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFallingThund.name: Falling Thunder
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFallingThund.description: Suffuse your Quarterstaff with electrical energy, then Slam the ground to deal damage in a large cone in front of you. Consumes your Power Charges to fire Lightning Projectiles forwards from the impact.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFerociousRoa.name: Ferocious Roar
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFerociousRoa.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and roar in defiance, immediately gaining Rage if there are enemies nearby and Empowering subsequent Attacks to Break Armour. Alternatively, socketing a human-form Warcry into this Skill triggers that Warcry instead, and augments its damage and area. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirebolt.name: Firebolt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirebolt.description: Launch a fiery Projectile towards a target. The Projectile explodes on impact, damaging foes in a small area.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirestorm.name: Firestorm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirestorm.description: Rain a storm of flaming bolts over the targeted area. Can Consume all three types of Elemental Infusion, creating a much larger storm when Fire-Infused, causing lightning bolts when Lightning-Infused, and raining ice bolts when Cold-Infused.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlameWall.name: Flame Wall
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlameWall.description: Create a wall of Fire in front of you, which Ignites everything within its area. Any Projectiles fired through the wall by you and Allies deal added Fire damage. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to also add Lightning damage to the Projectiles.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlameblast.name: Flameblast
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlameblast.description: Channel to build destructive energy around you. Releasing the energy causes a devastating explosion that is larger and more intense the longer you Channel for.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlammability.name: Flammability
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlammability.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Fire Resistance.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlickerStrik.name: Flicker Strike
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlickerStrik.description: Teleport to an enemy and Strike them. Consumes Power Charges to perform additional teleporting Strikes on nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFragmentsOfT.name: Fragments Of The Past
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFragmentsOfT.description: Spend Runic Ward to create a Verisium volcano that deals damage on initial eruption and Triggers Ice Fragments.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFreezingShar.name: Freezing Shards
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFreezingShar.description: Launch icy Projectiles in a sweeping arc. Multiple Projectiles can hit the same enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostBomb.name: Frost Bomb
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostBomb.description: Create a pulsing Orb of frost. Each pulse inflicts Elemental Exposure on nearby enemies. When the Orb's duration ends, it Detonates, dealing Cold damage to surrounding enemies and leaving behind a Cold Infusion.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostWall.name: Frost Wall
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostWall.description: Create a wall of Ice Crystals which holds back enemies. The Crystals explode if sufficiently damaged, or if pushed hard enough, damaging nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to add another Lightning explosion if destroyed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostbolt.name: Frostbolt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostbolt.description: Fire a slow-moving Piercing Projectile that is effective at Chilling enemies and explodes on colliding with terrain.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostflameNo.name: Frostflame Nova
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostflameNo.description: Unleash a wave of volatile ice that feeds on flames. While the wave doesn't deal damage, the ice latches onto Ignited enemies, refreshing the duration of their active Ignite and rapidly Freezing them but preventing them from being Ignited further until the Ignite expires.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFungalTerrai.name: [DNT] Fungal Terrain
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFungalTerrai.description: DNT Conjure a field of hazardous mushrooms that explode when enemies make contact. The explosion deals Physical damage and leaves a spore cloud that deals Chaos damage over time to enemies that enter the space.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFuriousSlam.name: Furious Slam
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFuriousSlam.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and Slam the ground with great force, causing a pair of shockwaves. Can spend Rage to create larger shockwaves that leave behind Jagged Ground.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFuturePast.name: Future-Past
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFuturePast.description: Hinekora observes your Future-Past granting you the opportunity to subvert a lesser fate. After a period of Hindsight, she will grant you her Foresight, which prevents you from avoiding Hits while Dodge Rolling. When you are Hit while Dodge Rolling, Hinekora restores you to full Life immediately before taking damage from the Hit, and grants you Sight Beyond Sight, which prevents you from dying.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGalvanicFiel.name: Galvanic Field
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGalvanicFiel.description: Gain a Buff that boosts your Shock chance. Shocking an enemy consumes the Buff to attach an Orb of electricity to that enemy. The Orb fires bolts of electricity at nearby enemies until it expires.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGelidPalm.name: Gelid Palm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGelidPalm.description: When you Hit with Unarmed Melee Attacks, projects icy wind which deal Unarmed Attack damage to all surrounding enemies and destroy Ice Crystals.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGhostDance.name: Ghost Dance
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGhostDance.description: While active, causes you to periodically gain Ghost Shrouds. If you are Hit while you have a Ghost Shroud, it is immediately consumed to recover Energy Shield based on your Evasion.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialCasca.name: Glacial Cascade
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialCasca.description: Sweep your Quarterstaff upwards, releasing an icy fissure which deals damage in a series of bursts culminating in a large spike. Frozen enemies hit by the final spike are dealt heavy damage but the Freeze is Consumed. Ice Crystals hit by the final spike explode.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialClash.name: Soaring Midnight
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialClash.description: Hurl your Shield as a Projectile which Returns to you at the end of its flight. While the Shield is in flight, this skill is replaced with Embrace the Fall. This skill's cooldown is skipped if you catch the Shield as it Returns, or destroy an Ice Crystal with the Embrace the Fall.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialLance.name: Glacial Lance
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialLance.description: Throw a single Piercing lance that leaves icy fragments in its wake. The fragments Chill nearby enemies. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to cause the glacial fragments created by the first Projectile to explode outwards after a short duration, peppering enemies with shrapnel.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGraveCommand.name: His Grave Command
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGraveCommand.description: Conjure Abyssal spirits to Hinder a Rare Undead for a duration. If you defeat the Undead while it is Hindered, it will be captured and stored into a Soul Crystal Skill Gem. The Soul Crystal will allow a wielder of great Abyssal power to summon the bound Undead as a Reviving Companion.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGrimPillars.name: Grim Pillars
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGrimPillars.description: Spend Runic Ward to cause damaging Ice-Crystal spears to erupt from the ground around you. These spears can be destroyed for an explosion of Cold damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHarbingerOfM.name: Harbinger of Madness
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHarbingerOfM.description: Draws out the latent fears of enemies you kill and Rare or Unique enemies you Hit, turning them into unstable apparitions which charge towards enemies and then explode.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHazardousHol.name: Kinetic Bash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHazardousHol.description: DNT Raise your Crossbow to Block all incoming Blockable hits. Releasing performs a Kinetic Bash, damaging enemies in front of you dealing more damage based on your Heavy Stun Buildup. While your Crossbow is raised Blocking too much damage may Heavy Stun you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfAsh.name: Herald of Ash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfAsh.description: While active, enemies you sufficiently Overkill with non-Herald Attacks will cause an explosion that Ignites nearby enemies based on the Overkill damage dealt.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfIce.name: Herald of Ice
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfIce.description: While active, Shattering an enemy with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause an icy explosion that deals Attack damage to surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfThun.name: Herald of Thunder
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfThun.description: While active, killing Shocked enemies with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause subsequent Attack Hits to release lightning bolts which dealAttack damage to all surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHexblast.name: Hexblast
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHexblast.description: Detonate a Curse on every enemy in an area, causing explosions of Chaos damage but removing the Curse. Can only detonate Curses for which at least half of the duration has expired.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHisFoulEmerg.name: His Foul Emergence
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHisFoulEmerg.description: Conjure a horrific skull rising from the lightless depths to bite your enemies dealing high damage at target location and leaving Withering Ground in its wake. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHisWinnowing.name: His Winnowing Flame
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHisWinnowing.description: Conjure an abyssal scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing Fire damage to enemies and Consuming Ignite to create pillars of flame. Cannot be Triggered.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHollowShell.name: Hollow Shell
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHollowShell.description: Sacrifice your Runic Ward to send out an energy pulse that grants nearby Allies Guard.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHyenaCackle.name: Cackling Companions
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHyenaCackle.description: Activate to summon a cackle of Hyena Companions. The cackle is treated as a single Companion for effects that count or limit Companions, regardless of the number of Hyenas in the cackle. Hyenas whoop when they first appear, Hindering nearby enemies, and have a chance to Maim enemies they Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHypothermia.name: Hypothermia
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHypothermia.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Cold Resistance.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceNova.name: Ice Nova
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceNova.description: Conjure a wave of ice in all directions, Knocking Back enemies based on how close they are to you. Casting Ice Nova targeting near a Frostbolt Projectile will cause it to originate from the Frostbolt instead of you. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to leave a patch of Chilled Ground.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceStrike.name: Ice Strike
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceStrike.description: Perform a fast icy Strike. Using this Attack three times in quick succession causes a final strike that is slower and more powerful.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemImpurity.name: Impurity
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemImpurity.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Chaos Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIncinerate.name: Incinerate
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIncinerate.description: Gain fuel by spending Mana on any Skill, then use the accumulated fuel to conjure a torrent of Fire from your hand, Igniting enemies in front of you. The flames grow stronger the longer you Channel. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to also create Ignited Ground. Cannot gain fuel while using this skill.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInfernalCry.name: Infernal Cry
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInfernalCry.description: Perform a Warcry, Empowering subsequent Melee Attacks if there are enemies nearby. Enemies in the warcry's area are destabilised and will Combust on death. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKillingPalm.name: Killing Palm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKillingPalm.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, Culling enemies if their life is low enough and performing additional dashing Strikes to other Cullable targets in range if your target was Culled. Each enemy killed by this strike grants a Power Charge, with higher Rarity monsters granting additional Charges. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKnifeFlip.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Knife Flip
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKnifeFlip.description: Fire an arc of knives in front of the caster which deals physical damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLeapSlam.name: Leap Slam
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLeapSlam.description:
Jump into the air, damaging and Knocking Back enemies with your mace where you land. Enemies you would land on are
pushed out of the way.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLeylines.name: Leylines
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLeylines.description: While active, areas of intense runic energy are revealed to you. Standing over them grants you a powerful Spell damage boost but constantly drains your Runic Ward. Running out of Runic Ward causes the energy to temporarily dissipate.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningArr.name: Lightning Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningArr.description: Fire a charged arrow at the target. On hitting an enemy or wall, the arrow will fire Chaining Lightning beams at nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningBol.name: Lightning Bolt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningBol.description: Call down a Shocking bolt of Lightning to strike enemies in a small area.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningCon.name: Lightning Conduit
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningCon.description: Call down Lightning to hit all enemies in a cone in front of you, dealing significantly more damage to Shocked enemies. If there is a Shocked enemy in the target area, additional lightning bolts are distributed among the targets hit. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningSpe.name: Lightning Spear
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningSpe.description: Throw a single copy of your spear. When it hits an enemy it bursts, firing secondary lightning bolt Projectiles at multiple other enemies within a large area around it. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to cause the main spear to split into multiple copies on impact, each of which then bursts.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningSpe.name: Thundergod's Wrath
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningSpe.description: While active, gains Energy when you Hit enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed Lightning spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningWar.name: Lightning Warp
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningWar.description: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. Can also be used on Ball Lightning Projectiles. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Lightning damage to surrounding enemies. If targeting an enemy, the explosion also creates Shocked Ground. Creates a Lightning Infusion on successful use. Highlights enemies that can be Culled.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLingeringIll.name: Lingering Illusion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLingeringIll.description: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will drop a Remnant that grants you a Power Charge on pickup.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemManaTempest.name: Mana Tempest
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemManaTempest.description: Create a storm of arcane energies that Empowers your Mana-costing Spells while you remain inside it. Maintaining the storm constantly drains your Mana, and spending more causes it to drain faster. The storm will dissipate when you exit it or run out of Mana.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMetaBowTotem.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Meta Bow Totem
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMetaBowTotem.description: Place a ballista totem which uses the socketed bow or wand attack skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMidnightStar.name: Midnight Zenith
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMidnightStar.description: While active, Critical Hits with other skills that kill targets, or hit powerful targets cause you to gain Arctic Petals. Once you have enough Arctic Petals they will be Consumed to create Ice Crystals near the most recent target.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMirrorOfRefr.name: Mirror of Refraction
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMirrorOfRefr.description: Mirrors of Refraction appear in your Presence periodically. Hitting a mirror with a Spell Projectile causes it to shatter, copying the projectiles in a nova around the destroyed mirror. Copied Projectiles may be copied again when colliding with other mirrors.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMistRaven.name: Mist Raven
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMistRaven.description: Summons a mysterious undamageable Mist Raven that can be Commanded to dive at target location, crashing through an otherworldly mirror and damaging enemies in an area. The raven grants you a Frenzy Charge for each enemy it Culls.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenCrash.name: Molten Crash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenCrash.description: Shapeshift into a burning monstrosity and leap through the air to crash down upon the earth, Slamming twice and creating Molten Fissures. Consumes Rage to create additional Molten Fissures.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenShower.name: Molten Shower
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenShower.description: Fires molten Projectiles from the enemy hit, which will explode when they land nearby, dealing Attack damage in an area.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOrbOfStorms.name: Orb of Storms
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOrbOfStorms.description: Create an Orb of electricity that fires Chaining Lightning bolts at nearby enemies. The Orb leaves behind a Lightning Infusion Remnant when it expires.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPainOffering.name: Pain Offering
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPainOffering.description:
Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike to send nearby Minions into a frenzy as long as the spike remains, making their skills faster and harder hitting. 
The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPlagueBearer.name: Plague Bearer
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPlagueBearer.description: While active, stores a portion of the Poison Damage you deal. Using this Skill unleashes the stored Poison to damage and Poison enemies around you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPowerSiphon.name: Power Siphon
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPowerSiphon.description: Attempt to rip the lifeforce from an enemy. Enemies within Culling range will be highlighted and instantly killed on Hit, granting a Power Charge. Can only target Enemies in Culling range.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoweredByVer.name: Powered by Verisium
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoweredByVer.description: Spends Ward to generate Verisium Infusions, which can be used in place of any Elemental Infusions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfFire.name: Purity of Fire
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfFire.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Fire Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfIce.name: Purity of Ice
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfIce.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Cold Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfLigh.name: Purity of Lightning
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfLigh.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Lightning Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRainOfArrows.name: Rain of Arrows
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRainOfArrows.description: Fire a hail of arrows into the air, causing them to rain from above. Consumes a Frenzy Charge to fire more arrows.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRainOfBlades.name: Rain of Blades
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRainOfBlades.description: Pour your Runic Ward into conjuring blades. For the duration of the Buff, these blades fall on enemies Hit by your Projectile Attacks.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRaiseZombie.name: Raise Zombie
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRaiseZombie.description: Consume a Corpse or Power Charge to create a short-lived Zombie. Zombies created from Power Charges are Empowered and also create two additional non-empowered Zombies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidAssault.name: Rapid Assault
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidAssault.description: Perform a series of six rapid stabs. The final stab inflicts Bleeding and leaves a spearhead stuck in the target, Maiming them for a duration. Detonator Skills will cause the stuck spearheads to explode, dealing further damage to the target and other nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemReap.name: Reap
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemReap.description: Conjure a bloody scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing Physical damage to enemies and applying Critical Weakness. Cannot be Triggered.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRefutation.name: Refutation
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRefutation.description: Spends all your Runic Ward to gain a short-duration Buff that causes you to Block all Blockable Hits and apply Parried to enemies from which you've Blocked a Hit. This Buff is removed if you are Heavy Stunned. While this Buff is active, you cannot be Light Stunned, but Blocking too much damage may Heavy Stun you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRemnantsOfKa.name: Remnants of Kalguur
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRemnantsOfKa.description: While active, enemies you Stun or kill have a chance to generate a Runic Ward Remnant. These Remnants can Overflow your Runic Ward.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRend.name: Rend
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRend.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and perform a wide slash with your wingtip claws. Consumes a Power Charge if possible to grant you a Buff that gives you extra Lightning damage. While you have the Buff, Rend covers a much larger area but is slower.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRepulsion.name: Repulsion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRepulsion.description: Spend Runic Ward to Curse enemies with a Verisium Rune, inflicting them with Fragility. Hitting these enemies removes the Curse to Trigger an explosion, Knocking Back nearby enemies and causing more Stun buildup based on the Fragility on the target Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRhoaMount.name: Rhoa Mount
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRhoaMount.description: Harnesses a Companion Rhoa you can mount while you're wielding a Bow or Spear. While mounted you can use Bow, thrown Spear, and Mark Skills, and are much less slowed while using Skills, but being Hit will cause Heavy Stun buildup. While you aren't mounted, the Rhoa will attack your enemies alongside you with its beak, but can be damaged.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRighteousDes.name: Righteous Descent
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRighteousDes.description: Leap into the air carried by divine wings, damaging enemies with your spear where you land. If there is a Fragment of Divinity near you or the targeted location, this attack will Consume it when you leap to become Empowered, dealing more damage and granting life and mana recovery. This skill does not use up its Cooldown when empowered.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRipwireBalli.name: Artillery Ballista
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRipwireBalli.description: Deploy a Ballista Totem that rains down a salvo of Pinning, Maiming bolts.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingMagma.name: Rolling Magma
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingMagma.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and lob a ball of magma that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skillChains, bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times. Impacts on Molten Fissures or Volcanos will activate them as though they were Slammed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingSlam.name: Rolling Slam
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingSlam.description: Slam the ground to Stun enemies and knock them away, then continue forward and perform a devastating second Slam.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRunicRepriev.name: Runic Reprieve
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRunicRepriev.description: Channel to create a protective bubble all around you, Blocking Hits against you. While Channelling this Skill, you cannot be Light Stunned by Hits you Block, and damage you take from Hits is also removed from Runic Ward. Blocking Hits this way causes you to accumulate Heavy Stun buildup. You cannot recover Runic Ward while this Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRunicTemperi.name: Runic Tempering
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRunicTemperi.description: Channel to imbue your armour with Runic Plates. When you are Hit while you have these plates, some of the damage you would take will be prevented, and this skill will cause backlash, dealing your Thorns damage in an area around your attacker.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSavageFury.name: Savage Fury
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSavageFury.description: While active, your Fury builds from Attacking enemies. Using this Skill releases your Fury to send you into a bestial frenzy, gaining damage and Onslaught but constantly losing life and forcing you into animal form. The frenzy ends immediately if you return to human form. You cannot gain Fury while in a frenzy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemScatteringCa.name: His Scattering Calamity
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemScatteringCa.description: Conjure a crackling Wellsprite that hovers above you. After a short duration, the Wellsprite launches at an enemy, dealing Lightning damage in an area on impact and prioritising the last enemy targeted. Recasting this spell resets the duration for all active Wellsprites.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSeismicCry.name: Seismic Cry
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSeismicCry.description: Perform a damaging Warcry, Knocking Back nearby enemies and Heavy Stunning enemies that are Primed for Stun. If an enemy is Heavy Stunned or a currently Heavy Stunned enemy is Hit, this Skill Empowers subsequent Slams to perform an additional Aftershock. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShatteringPa.name: Shattering Palm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShatteringPa.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them with an Attack that manifests a wave of cold, coating nearby enemies in shards of ice. Dealing enough damage to these enemies will shatter the shards, causing an icy explosion that deals Attack damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShatteringSp.name: Shattering Spite
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShatteringSp.description: Stamp your spear, destroying all Bloodstone Lances on each enemy in your Presence to cause a damaging explosion around that enemy. Each explosion gains new benefits when reaching higher thresholds of Bloodstone Lances removed from an enemy, causing them to deal more damage, have increased area of effect, and Leech Life from enemies caught in the blast.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShieldCharge.name: Shield Charge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShieldCharge.description: Channel to charge in the target direction. You will crash into enemies on your path, stopping your charge and dealing damage to enemies in an area, and extra damage to the enemies you collided with. While charging, your Shield is raised and you will Block all incoming Blockable hits.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockwaveTot.name: Shockwave Totem
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockwaveTot.description: Raise a Totem that Slams the ground around it, repeatedly damaging nearby enemies. Jagged Ground erupts when hit by this Slam, damaging enemies standing on it. The Totem cannot create Jagged Ground. This Skill can be used while Shapeshifted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShroud.name: Shroud
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShroud.description: Gain Stealth after not using Skills or being Hit for a short time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSigilOfLife.name: Rite of Restoration
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSigilOfLife.description: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful Buff to you and Allies standing in it which grants Life Regeneration and amplifies Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield. The Buff becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSigilOfPower.name: Sigil of Power
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSigilOfPower.description: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful Spell Damage Buff to you and Allies while standing in it. The Buff becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalArso.name: Skeletal Arsonist
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalArso.description: Activate to summon bomb-throwing, Reviving Skeletal Arsonists that can detonate other Minions on Command.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalBrut.name: Skeletal Brute
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalBrut.description: Activate to summon hard-hitting, Reviving Skeletal Brutes that can Stun Primed enemies and Warcry on Command. This Warcry Intimidates nearby enemies and Consumes Freeze on enemies and allies to deal damage in an Area around them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalCler.name: Skeletal Cleric
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalCler.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Clerics that heal other minions and revive fallen Skeletons.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalFros.name: Skeletal Frost Mage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalFros.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Frost Mages that can envelop your Minions in an icy shield on Command.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalReav.name: Skeletal Reaver
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalReav.description: Activate to summon aggressive, Reviving Skeletal Reavers that can enrage on Command. Skeletal Reavers do more Attack Damage and gain increased Attack speed based on their Rage

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalSnip.name: Skeletal Sniper
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalSnip.description: Activate to summon long-ranged, Reviving Skeletal Snipers that can fire a gas arrow on Command.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalStor.name: Skeletal Storm Mage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalStor.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Storm Mages that can call down a lightning strike on dead Skeletons on Command.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalWarr.name: Skeletal Sniper
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalWarr.description: Activate to summon long-ranged, Reviving Skeletal Snipers that can fire a gas arrow on Command.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalWarr.name: Skeletal Warrior
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalWarr.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Warriors.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkyfall.name: Skyfall
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkyfall.description: Build Glory by spending Runic Ward. When you have maximum Glory, you may call down a mass of Verisium from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location and summoning a Temporary Minion. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. Consumes a Verisium Infusion, if possible, to increase the number of Minions summoned.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSmashToSmith.name: Smash to Smithereens
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSmashToSmith.description: Blows strong enough to Heavy Stun an enemy reverberate in an area around the enemy and heavily Break Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSnipersMark.name: Sniper's Mark
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSnipersMark.description: Mark a target. The next Critical Hit the target receives Activates the Mark, Consuming it to deal extra damage and grant you a Frenzy Charge.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSoulCrystal.name: Soul Crystal: {0}
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSoulCrystal.description: Summon a Reviving Undead Companion to aid you in combat.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSoulrend.name: Soulrend
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSoulrend.description: Fire a Piercing Projectile that seeks out enemies. Enemies hit are inflicted with a Debuff that Hinders them and deals Chaos damage over time for a short duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpark.name: Spark
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpark.description: Launch a spray of sparking Projectiles that travel erratically along the ground until they hit an enemy or expire. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to fire many sparks in a circle.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpearfield.name: Spearfield
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpearfield.description: Stab the ground causing multiple spears to burst out of the ground in front of you in a large area. The spears remain for a duration, or explode when enemies touch them, damaging and Maiming them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpellTotem.name: Spell Totem
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpellTotem.description: Consume any combination of 3 Power and/or Endurance Charges to raise a Totem that uses socketed Spells. Cannot use Skills with Cooldowns.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpinningFlai.name: [DNT-UNUSED] Spinning Flail
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpinningFlai.description: DNT-UNUSED Advance forward, striking enemies around you with whirling swings of your flail.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiralVolley.name: Spiral Volley
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiralVolley.description: Load your Bow with a volley of enchanted arrows and fire them in a circle as you spin forward, firing directly at targets if possible. Consumes Frenzy Charges to cause the arrows to deal more damage and Chain to other targets. Each target can only be Hit once.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiralingCon.name: Spiraling Conspiracy
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiralingCon.description: A flock of mist ravens circle you, dealing damage over time in an area. Their numbers are bolstered by slain foes, or in the Presence of dangerous enemies, but the flock as a whole is considered a single minion. You can Command some of them to take flight, leaving the flock to assail your enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiritVessel.name: Spirit Vessel
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiritVessel.description: Summons a Shapeshifting Spirit Vessel Companion that uses copies of socketed Bear, Werewolf, and Wyvern Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStaggeringPa.name: Staggering Palm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStaggeringPa.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, instantly Heavily Stunning enemies which are Primed for Stun and performing additional dashing Strikes to other Primed targets in range if your first target was Stunned. Heavy Stunning an enemy with this Skill grants you a Buff that causes your Quarterstaff Attacks to also fire Projectiles for a short duration. Heavy Stunning additional enemies adds to the Buff's duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStarbornOnsl.name: Starborn Onslaught
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStarbornOnsl.description: Build up Glory by Freezing or Chilling enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may jump backwards loosing your Mace with the force of a falling comet onto your target. The impact releases Fissures and causes stars to fall in the area for a brief period.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonBeast.name: Companion: {0}
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonBeast.description: Summon a Reviving Beast Companion to aid you in combat.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonMercen.name: Summon Companion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonMercen.description: Summon a Reviving Companion to aid you in combat. The Mercenary will use socketed Attacks, and can be given equipment in the Skills Panel.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonSpectr.name: Spectre: {0}
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonSpectr.description: Summon the spirit of the bound monster as a Reviving Minion.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSunder.name: Sunder
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSunder.description: Slam the ground, creating a roiling fissure that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies. Hitting an enemy with Fully Broken Armour applies Sundered Armour, making it take additional increased Physical damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSupercharged.name: Supercharged Slam
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSupercharged.description: Channel to charge up a heavy swing, drawing earth from the ground to enlarge your mace. Release to Slam the ground, dealing damage in an area around the impact, followed by Aftershocks dealing damage in a larger area. This Skill has its own Attack time, which is not affected by your weapon's attack speed and cannot be modified.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTempestFlurr.name: Tempest Flurry
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTempestFlurr.description: Perform a series of aggressive Strikes. When used in quick succession, the third use Strikes three times, and the fourth use performs a Final Strike that calls down a powerful Shocking bolt.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTemporalChai.name: Temporal Chains
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTemporalChai.description: Curse all enemies in an area, Slowing them and making other effects on them expire more slowly.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTheStarsAnsw.name: The Stars Answer
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTheStarsAnsw.description: Leash the stars themselves by leveraging your vast magical power, repeatedly Triggering Starfall targeting an enemy in an area around you, or a random location in that area if no enemies can be targeted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThunderstorm.description: Conjure a thunderstorm which causes lightning strikes and torrential rain in an area. Enemies in the area are Drenched, causing them to become Shocked or Frozen more easily. Plants in the area become Overgrown.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTornado.name: Tornado
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTornado.description: Create a storm that sucks in enemies and deals Physical damage over time. A Tornado that overlaps an Elemental Ground Surface absorbs that surface's Debuff, applying it to enemies inside the Tornado and causing the Tornado to deal extra damage of that element.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTrailOfCaltr.name: Trail of Caltrops
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTrailOfCaltr.description: While active, scatters caltrops in your wake when you dodge.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTriskelionCa.name: Triskelion Cascade
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTriskelionCa.description: Tap into the power of the Triskelion Flame to Empower the next Cascadable Spell you cast. The Empowered Spell becomes centred on your location, and Cascades to six areas around you in a Triskelion pattern.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUniqueAtziri.name: Herald of the Royal Queen
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUniqueAtziri.description: Killing an enemy with Blood Loss will cause a bloody explosion that deals Physical Attack damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your Weapon Damage, but is based on their accumulated Blood Loss. The explosion destroys their Corpse if the enemy was Normal or Magic.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemValakosCharg.name: Valako's Charge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemValakosCharg.description: While active, taking Lightning damage builds up charge on you. Reaching full charge expends all charge to Trigger this skill, creating a Chaining lightning bolt that arcs to nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVerisiumMani.name: Verisium Manifestations
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVerisiumMani.description: While active, Hitting with an Attack will spend Runic Ward to summon a Verisium Manifestation, a short-lived Temporary Minion that rapidly Attacks nearby enemies, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVileDisrupti.name: His Vile Intrusion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVileDisrupti.description: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Physical damage to surrounding enemies and inflicts Impale.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolatileDead.name: Volatile Dead
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolatileDead.description: Consume a Corpse to create a volatile core that seeks out enemies and Ignites enemies near it. The core explodes at the end of its duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcanicFiss.name: Volcanic Fissure
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcanicFiss.description: Slam the ground, creating a branching Molten Fissure that deals damage as it travels and remains for a duration. Using a different Slam on a Molten Fissure creates a spreading Aftershock.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcano.name: Volcano
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcano.description: Uplift a volcano from the earth, damaging enemies standing on it and releasing a spray of molten Projectiles. While the volcano persists, Slamming it will cause another Projectile spray. Channelling this Skill for longer makes the initial eruption more violent, but does not affect subsequent Projectile sprays.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVoltaicBarri.name: Voltaic Barrier
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVoltaicBarri.description: Spend Runic Ward to raise a pair of electrified pylons in front of you which project a wall of electricity between them, damaging and Electrocuting enemies caught between them. Projectiles you fire through the wall become energised, and discharge that energy on Hit as Chaining Lightning beams.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVoltaicGrena.name: Voltaic Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVoltaicGrena.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that discharges an Electrocuting Lightning blast when its fuse expires, causing all Lightning Hits against enemies to contribute to Electrocution buildup for a duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVulnerabilit.name: Vulnerability
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVulnerabilit.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, making Hits against them ignore a portion of their Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWalkingCalam.name: Walking Calamity
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWalkingCalam.description: Build Glory by gaining Rage while already at maximum Rage. When you have maximum Glory, roar to the heavens to bring them down upon your enemies. For the duration of the Skill, meteors rain down around you and you Gain Fire damage and Rage regeneration. This Skill's effects are suppressed if you leave Bear form, but will resume if you return to Bear form before the duration expires.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWardboundMin.name: Wardbound Minions
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWardboundMin.description: Spend all your Runic Ward to summon Temporary Wardbound Casters. These Minions target nearby enemies with damaging Cold Spells.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWaveOfFrost.name: Wave of Frost
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWaveOfFrost.description: Flip backwards and send forth a Freezing wave in front of you, immediately Freezing enemies which are Primed for Freeze.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWhirlingAssa.name: Whirling Assault
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWhirlingAssa.description: Advance while hitting enemies around you with a series of spinning Strikes.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWhirlingSlas.name: Whirling Slash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWhirlingSlas.description: Perform a circular slash that kicks up a Whirlwind around you, Slowing enemies and Blinding them in its area of effect. Leaving the area collapses the storm, dealing damage and causing Knockback.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWindBlast.name: Wind Blast
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWindBlast.description: Batter enemies at range by generating a gust of wind as you swing. Enemies will be Dazed and Knocked Back based on how close they are to you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWither.name: Wither
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWither.description: Channel a debilitating hex that Withers enemies in the area.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfPack.name: Wolf Pack
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfPack.description: Activate to summon a pack of Wolf Companions. The pack treated as a single Companion for effects that count or limit Companions, regardless of the number of Wolves in the pack.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfPounce.name: Pounce
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfPounce.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and leap to a target location, damaging enemies in an area around where you land. Predator's Mark will be Triggered targeting the highest Rarity enemy Hit, or if a Mark gem is socketed into this Skill, that Mark will be Triggered instead. Using this Skill allows any Wolf Minions you have to leap immediately.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportEnervation.name: Enervation
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportEnervation.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to regenerate mana on shocking an enemy. Cannot support skills which create Minions, or skills used by Totems or Traps.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAccelerati.name: Projectile Acceleration I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAccelerati.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAccelerati.name: Projectile Acceleration III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAccelerati.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and causing increases and reductions to Projectile speed to also apply to Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAccelerati.name: Projectile Acceleration II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAccelerati.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and granting them a chance to Pierce Enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAftershock.name: Aftershock I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAftershock.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAftershock.name: Aftershock III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAftershock.description: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills a chance to create an Aftershock as well as increased chance to cause Aftershocks the longer their Attack time

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAftershock.name: Aftershock II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAftershock.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAhnsCitade.name: Ahn's Citadel
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAhnsCitade.description: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to instead be created along a fissure.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAilithLine.name: Ailith's Chimes
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAilithLine.description: Supports Skills which can expend Combo. On expending Combo with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain Power Charges based on the amount of Combo expended.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAmbush.name: Ambush
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAmbush.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Critically Hit enemies on full life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemArcaneSurg.name: Arcane Surge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemArcaneSurg.description: Supports Spells you cast yourself, tracking the mana you spend to cast them. Spending enough mana grants a burst of Mana Regeneration and Cast Speed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemArcaneTemp.name: Rapid Casting I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemArcaneTemp.description: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemArcaneTemp.name: Rapid Casting III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemArcaneTemp.description: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster for each different Spell you've cast in the last eight seconds.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemArcaneTemp.name: Rapid Casting II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemArcaneTemp.description: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAtaluiBloo.name: Atalui's Bloodletting
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemAtaluiBloo.description: Supports any Skill, turning a portion of its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit. Supported Skills Gain a portion of their Life cost as extra Physical Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBehead.name: Behead I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBehead.description: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBeheadTwo.name: Behead II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBeheadTwo.description: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal two Modifiers from Rare monsters they kill.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBhatairsVe.name: Bhatair's Vengeance
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBhatairsVe.description: Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with Supported Skills infuses you and your allies with Cold damage for a short time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBitingFros.name: Biting Frost I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBitingFros.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBitingFros.name: Biting Frost II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBitingFros.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze, leaving them Chilled. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBlazingCri.name: Blazing Critical
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBlazingCri.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Critical Hits with Supported Skills imbue all of your Attacks with Fire damage for a duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBlind.name: Blind I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBlind.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBlindTwo.name: Blind II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBlindTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit with increased effect.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBloodlust.name: Bloodlust
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBloodlust.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to deal more damage against Bleeding enemies, but preventing them from inflicting Bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBludgeon.name: Knockback
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBludgeon.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Knock Back enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBounty.name: Bounty I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBounty.description: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Flask and Charm charges.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBountyTwo.name: Bounty II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBountyTwo.description: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Flask and Charm charges.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBreakPostu.name: Break Posture
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBreakPostu.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Daze Enemies when they fully Break Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBrittleArm.name: Brittle Armour
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBrittleArm.description: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills which Freeze enemies cause Physical damage against them to Break their Armour while they remain Frozen.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBrutality.name: Brutality I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBrutality.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBrutalityT.name: Brutality III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBrutalityT.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types, as well as giving Hits from that skill a chance to ignore Physical Damage reduction.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBrutalityT.name: Brutality II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBrutalityT.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBrutusBrai.name: Brutus' Brain
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBrutusBrai.description: Supports skills which create Minions, causing those Minions to be unable to deal or take Damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBullseye.name: Heightened Accuracy I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBullseye.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBullseyeTw.name: Heightened Accuracy II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBullseyeTw.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy, and never miss against Enemies on full Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBurningIns.name: Burning Inscription
