Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBurningIns.description: Supports any Skill which creates Runic Inscriptions when Cast, causing those Runic Inscriptions to trigger Burning Inscription when they expire. Burning Inscription is a Spell which creates Ignited Ground based off of your Maximum Mana.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBurstingPl.name: Bursting Plague
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemBurstingPl.description: Supports skills that can Poison enemies, causing Poisoned enemies to gain Plague over time and explode in a Plague Burst on death. Cannot support the skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCannibalis.name: Cannibalism I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCannibalis.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCannibalis.name: Cannibalism II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCannibalis.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCatalysing.name: Catalysing Elements
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCatalysing.description: Supports Skills which are boosted by Elemental Ground Surfaces, Triggering Catalysing Discharge of the corresponding type when they are boosted by an allied Elemental Ground Surface.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemChain.name: Chain I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemChain.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemChainThree.name: Chain III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemChainThree.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemChainTwo.name: Chain II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemChainTwo.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemChaosInfus.name: Chaos Attunement
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemChaosInfus.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Chaos Damage but deal less Damage of other Types.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemChaosMaste.name: Chaos Mastery
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemChaosMaste.description: Supports Chaos skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemChargedMar.name: Charged Mark
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemChargedMar.description: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to Trigger Charged Mark when they are Activated. Charged Mark creates Shocked Ground at the target's location.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemClarity.name: Clarity I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemClarity.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemClarityTwo.name: Clarity II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemClarityTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCloseComba.name: Close Combat I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCloseComba.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCloseComba.name: Close Combat II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCloseComba.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemColdExposu.name: Cold Exposure
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemColdExposu.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when it inflicts Freeze.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemColdInfusi.name: Cold Attunement
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemColdInfusi.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Cold Damage but deal less Fire and Lightning Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemColdMaster.name: Cold Mastery
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemColdMaster.description: Supports Cold skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemColdPenetr.name: Cold Penetration
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemColdPenetr.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Cold resistance.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemComboFinis.name: Combo Finisher I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemComboFinis.description: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemComboFinis.name: Combo Finisher II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemComboFinis.description: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal massively more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemComorbidit.name: Escalating Poison
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemComorbidit.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing it to inflict an extra Poison on enemies but shortening the duration of those Poisons.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemConcentrat.name: Concentrated Area
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemConcentrat.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect, causing that area to be smaller but any area damage it deals to be higher.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemConcussive.name: Concussive Runes
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemConcussive.description: Supports Attacks, causing a Runic Shockwave to erupt under enemies they Heavy Stun. The Shockwave costs Runic Ward, and will not Trigger if you do not have enough Runic Ward.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemConcussive.name: Concussive Spells
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemConcussive.description: Supports Spells which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Daze on Critically Hitting enemies with Physical damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemConduction.name: Shock
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemConduction.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Shock.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemControlled.name: Controlled Destruction
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemControlled.description: Supports Spells that Hit enemies, boosting their damage but preventing them from dealing Critical Hits.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemControlled.name: Controlled Hazard
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemControlled.description: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to be unable to be triggered for 3 seconds after being created.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCorrosion.name: Corrosion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCorrosion.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Poison it applies to also Break enemy Armour. Cannot support skills that Consume Fully Broken Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCorrupting.name: Corrupting Cry I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCorrupting.description: Supports Warcries, Triggering Corrupted Cry to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCorrupting.name: Paquate's Pact
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCorrupting.description: Supports Warcries, Triggering Twisted Pact  to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect., at the cost of your Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCorrupting.name: Corrupting Cry II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCorrupting.description: Supports Warcries, Triggering Corrupted Cry to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCoursingCu.name: Shock Conduction
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCoursingCu.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCoursingCu.name: Shock Conduction II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCoursingCu.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy. Always Shocks enemies which are Drenched.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCreepingCh.name: Creeping Chill
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCreepingCh.description: Supports any Skill that creates Ice Crystals, causing that Skill to Consume a Power Charge if possible to create Chilled Ground around the Crystal.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCrescendo.name: Crescendo I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCrescendo.description: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCrescendoT.name: Crescendo III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCrescendoT.description: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to be Ancestrally Boosted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCrescendoT.name: Crescendo II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemCrescendoT.description: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession, and causing Non-Final Strike Attacks to be faster.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDeadlyCurr.name: Coursing Current
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDeadlyCurr.description: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Supported Skills Triggers Coursing Current, which sends Chaining Lightning Projectiles to nearby Drenched enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDeadlyHera.name: Deadly Herald
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDeadlyHera.description: Supports Herald Skills, making their triggered effects deal more damage at the expense of higher Spirit cost.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDeadlyPois.name: Deadly Poison I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDeadlyPois.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Poison.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDeadlyPois.name: Deadly Poison II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDeadlyPois.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Poison.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDecelerati.name: Projectile Deceleration I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDecelerati.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDecelerati.name: Projectile Deceleration II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDecelerati.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDeepCuts.name: Deep Cuts I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDeepCuts.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDeepCutsTw.name: Deep Cuts II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDeepCutsTw.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDeepFreeze.name: Deep Freeze
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDeepFreeze.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Freeze it inflicts to last longer.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDemolisher.name: Armour Demolisher I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDemolisher.description: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDemolisher.name: Armour Demolisher II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDemolisher.description: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDespoiler.name: Lasting Ground
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDespoiler.description: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those surfaces to last longer.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDevastate.name: Devastate
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDevastate.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to apply Broken Armour to enemies when causing a Heavy Stun to enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDiscombobu.name: Daze
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDiscombobu.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to build up Daze based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDrainAilme.name: Drain Ailments
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemDrainAilme.description: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to consume Ailments on enemies it applies damage over time Debuffs to in order to deal substantially more damage over time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEchoingCry.name: Echoing Cry
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEchoingCry.description: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills Echo twice, and their area grows larger each time, but are less effective and require you to have travelled a certain distance before use.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEinharsBea.name: Einhar's Beastrite
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEinharsBea.description: Supports Melee Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill for a lengthy duration, while being unable to damage enemies not on low Life. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemElectrocut.name: Electrocute
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemElectrocut.description: Supports any Skill which can deal Damage. Lightning Damage from Supported Skills can inflict Electrocute, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Shock.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemElementalA.name: Elemental Army
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemElementalA.description: Supports skills which create Minions, bolstering the Elemental Resistances of those Minions. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemElementalD.name: Elemental Discharge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemElementalD.description: Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to Consume Elemental Ailments on hit to trigger an Elemental Discharge. Cannot support the skills of Minions or skills which already Consume Elemental Ailments.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemElementalF.name: Elemental Focus
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemElementalF.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Elemental Damage but be unable to inflict Elemental Ailments.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEmpoweredS.name: Empowered Sparks I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEmpoweredS.description: Supports Skills which generate Charges. When generating Power Charge with Supported Skills, Empower some of your Attacks to Trigger Spark Projectiles on use.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEmpoweredS.name: Empowered Sparks II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEmpoweredS.description: Supports Skills which generate Charges. When generating Power Charge with Supported Skills, Empower some of your Attacks to Trigger Spark Projectiles on use.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEncumbranc.name: Slow Potency
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEncumbranc.description: Supports any skill, causing inflicted Slows to be more powerful.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEnergyBarr.name: Energy Barrier
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEnergyBarr.description: Supports any skill that you can use, causing Energy Shield recharge to begin immediately if you are Stunned while using it.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEnragedWar.name: Enraged Warcry I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEnragedWar.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEnragedWar.name: Enraged Warcry II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEnragedWar.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEnvenom.name: Poison I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEnvenom.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEnvenomThr.name: Poison III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEnvenomThr.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies and causing it to inflict more powerful Poisons against Bleeding Enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEnvenomTwo.name: Poison II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEnvenomTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEonyrsThun.name: Eonyr's Thunder
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEonyrsThun.description: Supports any Skill which can deal damage. Lightning damage from Supported Skills can inflict Electrocute, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Shock. Enemies slain while Electrocuted by Supported Skills explode, dealing a percentage of their maximum Life as Lightning damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEssenceHar.name: Essence Harvest
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEssenceHar.description: Supports Skills which create Reviving Persistent Minions. When those Minions die, you Recoup a percentage of your maximum Mana.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEternalFla.name: Eternal Flame I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEternalFla.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to be inflicted less often but last longer.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEternalFla.name: Eternal Flame III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEternalFla.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to refresh Ignites on Critical Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEternalFla.name: Eternal Flame II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEternalFla.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to last longer.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEternalMar.name: Eternal Mark
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemEternalMar.description: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to not be Consumed the first time they are Activated.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemExecute.name: Execute I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemExecute.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemExecuteThr.name: Execute III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemExecuteThr.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life, as well as dealing more damage while you are on Low Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemExecuteTwo.name: Execute II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemExecuteTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemExpand.name: Expand
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemExpand.description: Supports Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when cast, increasing area of effect. Cannot support Channelling Skills or Skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemExploitWea.name: Exploit Weakness
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemExploitWea.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more Damage against enemies with Broken Armour but preventing them from Breaking Armour themselves. Cannot support skills that Consume Broken Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemExplosiveG.name: Accelerated Growth
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemExplosiveG.description: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemExplosiveG.name: Accelerated Growth II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemExplosiveG.description: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown, Blinding enemies Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemExposingCr.name: Exposing Cry
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemExposingCr.description: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills apply Exposure on Hitting enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemFanTheFlam.name: Fan The Flames
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemFanTheFlam.description: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemFanTheFlam.name: Fan The Flames II

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemPrimalArma.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemProfusion.name: Charge Profusion I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemProfusion.description: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemProfusionT.name: Charge Profusion II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemProfusionT.description: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so, as well as a chance to generate an additional Charge of a random type.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRage.name: Rage I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRage.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRageThree.name: Rage III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRageThree.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit. Supported Skills have signficantly higher Attack speed while you or supported minion are not at maximum Rage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRageTwo.name: Rage II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRageTwo.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRendingApe.name: Rending Apex
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRendingApe.description: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to Break Armour based on a portion of Attack damage dealt.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRisingTemp.name: Rising Tempest
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRisingTemp.description: Supports Skills which deal Damage, raising Elemental Damage dealt for each Skill used Recently of a different Elemental type. Cannot support Minion Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRuneforged.name: Runeforged Blades
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRuneforged.description: Supports Attacks you use yourself, causing them to Consume Fully Broken Armour on enemies to fire a nova of runic Projectiles at the cost of Runic Ward. The Projectiles cannot Hit the enemy from which they originated. Cannot support skills that Consume Broken Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRunicExtra.name: Runic Extraction
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRunicExtra.description: Supports any Skill that deals damage. Enemies you kill with supported Skills have a chance to drop a Verisium Infusion Remnant.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRunicInfus.name: Runic Infusion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRunicInfus.description: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to cost Runic Ward to use but deal additional Physical damage based on their Runic Ward cost. Cannot Support Channelling Skills, Sustained Skills, or Skills without a cost.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRuthless.name: Ruthless
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemRuthless.description: Supports Attacks, causing repeated uses to be more effective at Stunning enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemScattersho.name: Multishot I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemScattersho.description: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemScattersho.name: Multishot II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemScattersho.description: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemScouringFl.name: Scouring Flame
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemScouringFl.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but the skill to gain a Runic Ward cost.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSearingFla.name: Searing Flame I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSearingFla.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSearingFla.name: Searing Flame II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSearingFla.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSecondWind.name: Second Wind I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSecondWind.description: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSecondWind.name: Second Wind III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSecondWind.description: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown and causing them to recover your Life when a Skill is used and goes on cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSecondWind.name: Second Wind II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSecondWind.description: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemShockSipho.name: Shock Siphon
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemShockSipho.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Energy Shield when it kills a Shocked enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSlamAfters.name: Tectonic Slams
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSlamAfters.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, causing them to create simultaneous Aftershocks behind the Slam, but lowering Aftershock damage and area of effect with Supported Skills. Cannot Support Skills which create Fissures.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSoulDrain.name: Soul Drain
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSoulDrain.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Mana when it Culls an enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSoulThief.name: Mana Leech
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSoulThief.description: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Mana.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSpellEcho.name: Spell Echo
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSpellEcho.description: Supports Cascadable Spells you use yourself. Supported Spells Echo.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSplinter.name: Armour Break I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSplinter.description: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSplinterTh.name: Armour Break III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSplinterTh.description: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSplinterTw.name: Armour Break II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSplinterTw.description: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSpreadingF.name: Spreading Frost
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSpreadingF.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, causing them to Chill enemies near enemies they Freeze.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemStormfire.name: Stormfire
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemStormfire.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Enemies Shocked by Supported Skills take a percentage of damage from Ignite as Lightning damage as well as Fire damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSupercriti.name: Supercritical
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemSupercriti.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage with Critical Hits but have less Critical Hit chance.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemThrillOfTh.name: Thrill of the Kill
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemThrillOfTh.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage for a short time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemThrillOfTh.name: Thrill of the Kill II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemThrillOfTh.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage and grants an increased chance to Shock for a short time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemUnbreakabl.name: Unbreakable
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemUnbreakabl.description: Supports any skill that you can use, making you harder to Stun while using it.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemUnleash.name: Unleash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemUnleash.description: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemUruksSmelt.name: Uruk's Smelting
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemUruksSmelt.description: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger. Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills permanently increases the Physical Damage taken by those affected, up to a cap.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemVilentasPr.name: Vilenta's Propulsion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemVilentasPr.description: Supports Spell Skills that fire Projectiles, causing increases and reductions to cast speed to also apply to Projectile speed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemVitality.name: Vitality I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemVitality.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemVitalityTw.name: Vitality II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemVitalityTw.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemWildfire.name: Wildfire
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemWildfire.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, Spreading Ignites it inflicts to nearby enemies after a delay.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemWindWave.name: Wind Wave
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemWindWave.description: Supports any skill that you can use, triggering a blast of wind that Knocks Back enemies if you are Stunned while using it.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemWindowOfOp.name: Window of Opportunity I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemWindowOfOp.description: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemWindowOfOp.name: Window of Opportunity II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemWindowOfOp.description: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage and grant Perfect Deflection if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemWitheringT.name: Withering Touch
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemWitheringT.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Wither enemies on Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemZarokhsRev.name: Zarokh's Revolt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportGemZarokhsRev.description: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time and giving them a moderate Cooldown. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown or gain seals.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportOlrothsConvic.name: Olroth's Conviction
Metadata/Items/Gems/SupportOlrothsConvic.description: Supports skills that can Empower a specific number of other skills, causing them to apply to more skill uses.

Metadata/Items/Gems/UniqueSkillGemHerald.name: Herald of Ash
Metadata/Items/Gems/UniqueSkillGemHerald.description: While active, enemies you sufficiently Overkill with non-Herald Attacks will cause an explosion that Ignites nearby enemies based on the Overkill damage dealt.

Metadata/Items/Gems/UniqueSkillGemHerald.name: Herald of Ice
Metadata/Items/Gems/UniqueSkillGemHerald.description: While active, Shattering an enemy with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause an icy explosion that deals Attack damage to surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/UniqueSkillGemHerald.name: Herald of Thunder
Metadata/Items/Gems/UniqueSkillGemHerald.description: While active, killing Shocked enemies with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause subsequent Attack Hits to release lightning bolts which dealAttack damage to all surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/UniqueSkillGemWither.name: Withering Presence
Metadata/Items/Gems/UniqueSkillGemWither.description: While active, emits an Aura that periodically Withers enemies in your Presence.

Metadata/items/Gems/SkillGemStaffConsecr.name: Consecrate
Metadata/items/Gems/SkillGemStaffConsecr.description: Create an area of Consecrated Ground around you.

Metadata/items/Gems/SkillGemStaffUnleash.name: Unleash
Metadata/items/Gems/SkillGemStaffUnleash.description: Augment yourself with temporal magic for a short duration, Empowering the next Repeatable Spell you cast to Repeat multiple times. Cannot Empower Skills with a Cooldown.
